【Shenzhen Exchange To Steadily Expand Market-Connects, Study QFII Refinements, Promote Overseas ETFs】At the Shenzhen Stock Exchange 2026 Global Investors Conference on May 28, director Chang Shayan said the exchange will deepen implementation of the latest round of capital-market opening measures to facilitate foreign investment in A-shares. He outlined three next steps: first, steadily expand market-connect mechanisms and study and refine measures to optimize and implement the QFII system to better serve coordinated development of onshore and offshore markets; second, broaden and diversify product supply, strengthen international cooperation on index compilation, and actively promote development of overseas ETF products; third, enhance service systems for listed companies and international investors, support and guide listed companies to orderly expand international operations, further enrich information provision to overseas investors, and continuously improve market transparency and predictability.

【國際空間站兩名俄宇航員完成約6小時艙外作業】國際空間站兩名俄羅斯宇航員於莫斯科時間27日23時許（北京時間28日4時許），順利完成約6小時的艙外作業，在國際空間站外部安裝了新的實驗裝置，並取回之前放在艙外的實驗容器。據俄國家航天集團27日透過社交媒體釋出的訊息，留在國際空間站內的另一名俄宇航員安德烈·費佳耶夫透過遙控操縱艙外機械臂，將謝爾蓋·庫季-斯韋爾奇科夫和謝爾蓋·米卡耶夫託舉到指定位置實施作業。這兩名宇航員在俄羅斯艙段“星辰”號服務艙外安裝了一臺射電望遠鏡。該裝置將有助探究太陽耀斑發生機制，提升太陽耀斑預測的準確性。太陽耀斑是太陽上最劇烈的活動現象之一，可能導致地球磁場方向與強度急劇變化，引發地磁暴。（新華社）

【深交所理事長沙雁：穩步拓展互聯互通機制 研究細化QFII制度最佳化落實舉措】5月28日，深交所2026全球投資者大會在深圳開幕。深交所理事長沙雁在致辭時談及了最近兩次深交所全球投資者大會的感受，她說：“一年來，中國經濟持續展現強大韌性、資本市場鞏固回穩向好勢頭，我們明顯感覺到，境外投資者來得更多了，投資對接的企業面更廣了，對中國經濟創新發展和轉型升級的認識更深入了，對中國資本市場的信心更足了。”沙雁表示，下一步，深交所將深入落實新一輪擴大資本市場開放部署，便利境外投資者投資A股。一是穩步拓展互聯互通機制，研究細化QFII制度最佳化落實舉措，更好服務在岸與離岸市場協同發展。二是豐富多元化產品供給，加強指數編制國際合作，積極推動境外ETF產品開發。三是完善面向上市公司和國際投資者的服務體系，支援和引導上市公司有序佈局國際化業務，進一步豐富面向境外投資者的資訊供給，不斷增強市場透明度與可預期性。

【Japan-Backed Fund Said to Weigh Sale of Chip-Materials Maker JSR】According to foreign media citing people familiar with the matter, government-backed fund Japan Industrial Innovation Investment Corporation (JIC) is considering selling chip-materials maker JSR. Two years ago JIC took JSR private in a roughly $6.0 billion transaction. JIC, regulated by METI and established in 2018 to bolster Japanese competitiveness through corporate investment, has drawn acquisition interest from Fujifilm and Mitsubishi Chemical, the sources said. Large-scale investment in artificial intelligence has driven up valuations across the chip supply chain; JIC had initially planned to use JSR to promote consolidation in the materials sector but is now weighing a sale to capitalize on favorable market conditions. Founded in 1957, JSR is a leading photoresist maker; photoresists are used to transfer circuit patterns onto semiconductor wafers. In the fiscal year ended March this year, JSR posted net profit of 60.7 billion yen and revenue of 400.7 billion yen.

【特朗普修改訴狀 再度起訴《華爾街日報》出版商誹謗】美國總統特朗普於週三向《華爾街日報》出版商提起修訂後的訴訟。此前一篇報道提及他曾給聲名狼藉的金融家、性犯罪者傑弗裡・愛潑斯坦寫生日信，特朗普就此起訴對方誹謗，但該案早前已被法官駁回。邁阿密聯邦地區法官達林・蓋爾斯此前要求特朗普在5月27日前提交新訴狀。法院駁回原訴的原因是，訴狀未能充分證明被告存在實際惡意。這一法律標準要求原告證實：被告刊發報道時，明知內容虛假，或全然罔顧事實真相。新訴狀從多個方面指控被告存在上述惡意，並援引特朗普多次否認與這封信件存在關聯的表態。和原訴狀一致，本次訴訟仍索賠數十億美元。

【習近平復信參加“共航蔚藍：中美青年友誼行”活動的兩國學生】5月23日，國家主席習近平復信參加“共航蔚藍：中美青年友誼行”活動的兩國學生。

習近平表示，很高興得知兩國學生搭乘“中美青年友誼號”，共同經歷了難忘的友誼之旅。中美友好的故事由人民書寫，中美關係的未來由青年創造。2023年11月我提出“5年邀請5萬名美國青少年來華交流學習”倡議以來，已有超過5萬名美國青少年來華參訪，提前兩年半實現預期目標。在交往交流中，中美兩國青少年雙向奔赴，加深相互瞭解和理解，結下深厚友誼，書寫了兩國人民友好交流的嶄新篇章。

【Private-Sector Pay Attracts Top Talent, BOK Sees Rising Voluntary Departures】As staff pursue higher-paying roles in technology, academia and international finance, voluntary departure applications at the BOK are rising. Park Seong-hoon, a People Power Party lawmaker, obtained data from the BOK on Wednesday showing that as of May this year 17 employees had applied to leave voluntarily for job changes, further study and other reasons. Employees in their 40s accounted for the largest share with six departures, followed by four in their 30s and one in their 20s. The trend resembled last year, when professionals in their 40s were also the main voluntary leavers, with 10 departures, exceeding all other age groups. In recent years annual departures among mid-level staff in their 40s rose from 7 in 2021 to 10 in 2023, fell to 6 in 2024 and then returned to 10 last year. Some observers said large firms such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have paid performance bonuses of up to several hundred million won, which has heightened feelings of relative deprivation inside the BOK.

【XI / CHINA And Austrian President Van der Bellen Exchange Congratulatory Messages On 55th Anniversary Of China-Austria Diplomatic Relations】On May 28, XI / CHINA and Austrian President Van der Bellen exchanged congratulatory messages marking the 55th anniversary of diplomatic ties between China and Austria. XI / CHINA said that over 55 years since establishing relations, China-Austria ties have endured challenges and maintained healthy, stable development. He noted that in 2018 he and President Van der Bellen jointly designated China-Austria relations as a friendly strategic partnership, launching a new phase in bilateral cooperation, and that in May last year a new pair of panda envoys appeared in Vienna, further deepening people-to-people friendship. With the current international situation turbulent and intertwined, XI / CHINA said China and Austria — as promoters of world peace, supporters of multilateralism and defenders of free trade — should jointly uphold mutual respect and trust, openness and inclusiveness, and cooperation for mutual benefit. He said he attaches great importance to the relationship and is willing to work with President Van der Bellen to use the 55th anniversary as an opportunity to raise China-Austria ties to a new level and make a greater contribution to world peace and development.

【Foreign Investors Buy Japanese Stocks For Eighth Week To May 23 As AI Names Rally】Foreign investors bought Japanese shares for an eighth straight week in the week to May 23, supported by a retreat in oil prices and gains in AI-related names after a stronger demand outlook, data from Japan’s Ministry of Finance released on Thursday showed. Net foreign purchases of Japanese equities totaled JPY1.08 tln (USD6.77 bln) in the week to May 23, up nearly 14% from JPY948.4 bln in the prior week. The technology sector drew heavy flows after NVIDIA last week forecast explosive demand for its flagship AI chips; SoftBank Group shares jumped 17.62% last week and chip designer Socionext rose 12.26%. Year-to-date, foreign investors have poured roughly JPY11.7 tln into Japanese stocks, compared with about JPY742.1 bln of net buying in the same period a year earlier. On the bond front, as the earlier sell-off eased and rising yields attracted buyers, Japanese long-term bonds saw net inflows of JPY1.35 tln after a JPY1.03 tln outflow the previous week. However, foreign investors trimmed short-term bond holdings by JPY2.22 tln, the largest reduction since March 28.

【習近平同蘇利南總統西蒙斯就中蘇建交50週年互致賀電】5月28日，國家主席習近平同蘇利南總統西蒙斯互致賀電，慶祝兩國建交50週年。

習近平指出，中蘇友誼源遠流長、歷久彌堅。半個世紀以來，雙方始終相互尊重、平等相待，在涉及彼此核心利益和重大關切問題上堅定相互支援，持續深化互利合作，為兩國人民帶來實實在在的福祉。我高度重視中蘇關係發展，願同西蒙斯總統一道努力，以兩國建交50週年為新起點，增進戰略互信，賡續傳統友誼，推動各領域務實合作取得更多成果，共同書寫中蘇戰略合作伙伴關係新篇章。

西蒙斯表示，建交50年來，蘇中關係持續深入發展，兩國友誼牢固深厚，戰略合作日益緊密。我十分珍視兩國在各領域合作的豐碩成果，展望下一個50年，期待雙方進一步增進團結、深化和拓展合作，實現繁榮發展的共同願景。

【緬北徐發啟犯罪集團案二審宣判】2026年5月28日，重慶市高階人民法院對徐發啟犯罪集團上訴案公開宣判，裁定駁回上訴，維持原判，並依法核准被告人徐發啟死刑，緩期二年執行。

重慶市第五中級人民法院一審認定，2019年以來，以徐發啟為首要分子、羅玉軍等武裝頭目為重要成員的犯罪集團，利用徐發啟在緬甸果敢地區的影響力，與電詐犯罪集團合作，陸續修建開設多個詐騙園區實施電信網路詐騙，涉詐資金11餘億元，並在武裝庇護過程中，夥同電詐犯罪集團故意傷害不服從管理的涉詐人員，致一人死亡、一人輕傷。徐發啟還結夥實施了走私、販賣毒品等犯罪。重慶市第五中級人民法院分別以詐騙罪、故意傷害罪、走私、販賣毒品罪等六項罪名，對被告人徐發啟判處死刑，緩期二年執行；對被告人張龍龍判處無期徒刑；對被告人羅玉軍、習康強、劉世兵判處二十五年至十四年不等有期徒刑，並相應判處沒收財產、罰金等附加刑。宣判後，被告人張龍龍、習康強、劉世兵提出上訴。

重慶市高階人民法院認為，一審判決認定的事實清楚，證據確實、充分，定罪準確，量刑適當，審判程式合法。各上訴人的上訴理由及辯護人的辯護意見不能成立。遂依法作出終審裁定。

當事人親屬和各界群眾旁聽了宣判。

【英國5月份房價上漲 受首次購房者提振】房地產網站Zoopla表示，隨著首次購房者尋求購買更高價值的房屋，英國5月份房價上漲了1.5%。Zoopla週四表示，5月份英國房屋平均售價為271,900英鎊（合365,597美元），其中首次購房者支付的價格約為254,750英鎊，較去年同期上漲4.3%。Zoopla表示，儘管買家需求下降了10%，但當月達成交易的房屋數量仍增長了1%。其中，進入市場的首次購房者數量下降了6%。Zoopla執行董事理查德.唐內爾(Richard Donnell)表示：“儘管買家詢價量低於去年，但隨著房貸利率走低，堅定的購房者繼續推進交易，因此達成的交易量增加。”

【深圳一企業稱股權價值被嚴重低估續：重估高出近23倍，當事人認為仍未反映市場價值】鷗富實業（深圳）有限公司（下稱：鷗富公司）半數股權被拍賣一事有了新進展。5月27日，從鷗富公司負責人袁先生處獲悉，深圳市公平衡資產評估有限公司（下稱：公平衡公司）已於3月27日作出《資產評估報告》，歐富公司51%股權價值為2.09億元，是初次評估價值876.65萬元的近24倍。28日，深圳市中級法院對該部分股權進行拍賣，起拍價為1.46億元。截至發稿前，該拍賣尚無人報名。袁先生仍認為，公平衡公司作出的評估報告仍存在重大遺漏，依然未能反映出該公司的真實市場價值，此次拍賣應當中止。此外袁先生認為，法院此次重新評估價值不應採取“順延”的方式選定評估機構，而應由雙方現場搖號選定評估公司對被漏評或低評資產重新評估。5月28日上午，深圳市中院執行局相關負責人表示，將瞭解一下情況。截至發稿前，該負責人未進一步回應。（澎湃新聞）

【UOB Economists: Thailand Growth Headwinds Persist Despite Fiscal Package】UOB economists said in a report that despite the government’s recently announced fiscal package, growth headwinds remain in Thailand. Domestic demand is still uneven, and the risk of an energy shock is weighing on consumer confidence and employment. The new co-payment program, designed to ease living costs and stimulate local economies, should be viewed as a targeted fiscal shock absorber rather than a conventional demand-boosting stimulus. UOB maintains forecasts for Thailand GDP growth of 1.5% in 2026 and 2.4% in 2027, compared with a 2.4% increase recorded in 2025.

【美伊緊張局勢加劇通脹擔憂  金價跌至兩月低位】週四，受美國再度打擊伊朗影響，美元走強、油價走高，市場通脹憂慮升溫，利率前景也變得不明朗，國際金價隨之跌至兩個月來低點。現貨黃金下跌1.7%，報每盎司4380.62美元，盤中一度觸及3月26日以來最低價位。6月交割的美國黃金期貨跌幅達1.6%，報4377.10美元。美元匯率升至一週高位，以美元計價的黃金對其他貨幣持有者而言成本上升。StoneX資深分析師馬特・辛普森表示：“地緣政治緊張態勢依舊嚴峻，和平談判也多次傳出不實利好訊息。因此美元料將持續受到買盤支撐，金價大機率會繼續承壓。”

【國家藥監局：藥品市場獨佔期制度具體實施檔案正在制訂中】5月28日，自然資源部召開5月例行新聞釋出會，釋出並解讀《關於加快海洋藥物和功能製品高質量發展的指導意見》。在加強智慧財產權保護方面，國家藥監局藥品註冊管理司副司長於江泳表示，目前，國家藥監局已會同智慧財產權局建立了藥品專利糾紛早期解決機制。新修訂《中華人民共和國藥品管理法實施條例》（以下簡稱《條例》）對藥品試驗資料保護制度進一步完善，並建立兒童用藥品和罕見病治療用藥品的市場獨佔期制度。5月15日，《藥品試驗資料保護實施辦法》已與《條例》同步實施，市場獨佔期制度具體實施檔案也正在緊鑼密鼓地制訂中，這些制度將進一步加強對創新藥物的智慧財產權保護，激發企業對于海洋藥物研製的創新動能。

【NMPA Says Implementation Documents For Drug Market Exclusivity Period Are Being Drafted】At a May 28 regular press briefing, the Ministry of Natural Resources published and explained the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating High-Quality Development of Marine Drugs and Functional Products. On intellectual property protection, Yu Jiangyong, deputy director of the Drugs Registration Management Department at the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA), said the NMPA and the China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA) have established an early-resolution mechanism for drug patent disputes. The newly revised Implementing Regulations of the PRC Drug Administration Law (the Regulations) further strengthen protection for drug trial data and establish a market exclusivity-period system for pediatric medicines and drugs for rare diseases. The Measures for the Protection of Drug Trial Data took effect simultaneously with the Regulations on May 15, and the Regulations’ specific implementation documents for the market exclusivity system are currently being intensively drafted. NMPA said these measures will further bolster IP protection for innovative drugs and stimulate firms’ innovation momentum in marine drug R&D.

【受中東衝突影響 豐田汽車銷量連續三月下滑】受中東衝突引發的供應鏈擾動波及，豐田汽車全球銷量連續第三個月同比走低，其對該地區的出口量銳減超九成。豐田週四公佈，4月含子公司大發汽車在內的全球銷量為902015輛，同比下降3.7%；同期產量則同比增長3.4%，達933685輛。相較於其他車企，豐田受此次衝突衝擊較小。儘管霍爾木茲海峽航運受阻，旗下工廠仍維持運轉。但若供應緊張局面持續、零部件出現短缺，豐田的抗風險能力將迎來考驗，也會凸顯全球車企對海灣地區零部件、原材料及能源供應的高度依賴。

【中東局勢推高運費 美國液化氣買家取消船貨訂單】受中東衝突影響，海運運費大幅飆升，部分美國液化石油氣買家取消了原本發往亞洲的貨運訂單。據不願具名的知情人士透露，已有至少兩批原定下月從美國墨西哥灣沿岸出口碼頭裝船的貨物被取消，還有部分買家正商議取消更多訂單。這些人士因無權對外發聲，故而選擇匿名。中東局勢導致霍爾木茲海峽近乎停運，波斯灣地區的供氣通道受阻，亞洲液化石油氣買家此前不得不緊急增購美國貨源。衡量美國液化氣出口東亞利潤的核心指標 —— 遠東指數 - 蒙特貝爾維尤價差持續收窄，疊加運費大漲，貿易商原本可觀的收益已被完全吞噬。

【Ministry Of Industry And Information Technology Expediting Draft Of 15th Five-Year Plan For Pharmaceutical Industry】On May 28, at its regular monthly press briefing the Ministry of Natural Resources released and explained the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating High-Quality Development of Marine Drugs and Functional Products. Wang Xiaoyang, deputy director of the Department of Consumer Goods Industry at the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, said MIIT is expediting preparation of the "15th Five-Year Plan for Pharmaceutical Industry" and is arranging to accelerate the development of "innovative medicines", "inclusive medicines", "digital-intelligence medicines" and "open medicines". The plan will designate marine drugs and functional products as priority development areas and, through improving top-level design, will further clarify development direction, specify development tasks, and provide clear guidance for the industry's high-quality development.

【報道：國家大基金領投DeepSeek，投前估值450億美元】 近期，AI（人工智慧）大模型公司DeepSeek(深度求索)首輪融資洽談已接近尾聲。參與交易談判的投資人稱，本輪融資由國家積體電路產業投資基金（簡稱“國家大基金”）領投，數家市場化投資機構也在談判名單上。今年4月以來，一級市場情緒高漲，DeepSeek成為炙手可熱的投資標的，一名接近交易人士稱，“所有人都想接觸（DeepSeek），但沒有一個人保證百分百投進去。”不到最後一刻，參投方和投資金額都存在變數。不過，該人士最新透露，首輪融資名單在本月底已基本敲定。（財經）

【工信部：正在抓緊編制《醫藥工業發展“十五五”規劃》】5月28日，自然資源部召開5月例行新聞釋出會，釋出並解讀《關於加快海洋藥物和功能製品高質量發展的指導意見》。工業和資訊化部消費品工業司副司長王孝洋表示，工信部正在抓緊編制《醫藥工業發展“十五五”規劃》，部署加快打造“創新醫藥”“普惠醫藥”“數智醫藥”“開放醫藥”。規劃將把海洋藥物和功能製品納入重點發展領域，透過完善頂層設計，進一步明確發展方向、細化發展任務，為產業高質量發展提供清晰指引。

【嘉興南湖機場首條國際貨運航線正式開通】5月28日，嘉興南湖機場首條國際貨運航線正式開通。當日上午，一架裝載電子電器、藥品和紡織服裝等貨物的圓通航空“嘉興號”（B767-300F）全貨機從嘉興南湖機場緩緩滑出，飛往孟加拉國達卡機場。據悉，除當日已開通的首條國際貨運航線外，嘉興南湖機場年內還將陸續開通19條國際貨運航線，屆時航線總數將達20條，其中亞洲9條、歐洲6條、美洲5條，初步構建起“輻射亞洲、通達歐美”的國際貨運航線網路。（新華社）

【泰國4月工廠產值同比下降0.36%，不及預期】泰國工業部週四公佈，該國4月製造業生產指數同比下滑0.36%，表現低於分析師預期。此前媒體調查顯示，市場預期該指數同比上漲0.2%；而3月資料經修正後，同比增幅為1.30%。泰國全年工廠產值預計增長1.0%至2.0%，較此前預估的1.5%至2.5%有所下調。泰國工業部表示，產值下滑受中東局勢衝突、成本高企擠壓企業利潤影響。同時，作為經濟主要支柱的旅遊業景氣走弱，也拖累了相關產業。資料顯示，今年一季度泰國工廠產值同比增長0.94%。該部門還稱，預計5月產值環比將有所回升。

【中使館提醒在泰國中國公民自覺抵制任何形式賭博活動】近年來，不少中國公民在海外參賭涉賭並深受其害，不僅蒙受鉅額財產損失，甚至引發綁架、勒索、非法拘禁等惡性刑事案件，嚴重威脅人身安全。為保障廣大旅泰同胞的合法權益，中國駐泰國使館鄭重提醒：賭博害人害己，一次沉迷，終生悔恨！請務必認清跨境賭博陷阱，自覺抵制任何形式賭博活動，切勿以身試法。一、跨境賭博已入刑，法律紅線不可碰泰國法律嚴格禁止非法賭博及網路博彩活動。我國刑法修正案已明確將跨境賭博入刑，即使境外賭場合法開設，中國公民跨境賭博也涉嫌觸犯我國法律，特別是對於組織賭博、開設賭場、招攬中國公民參賭等行為，我國司法機關將依法追究刑事責任。二、認清賭博騙局，拒絕誘惑警惕“殺豬盤”：跨境賭博常與電信詐騙、非法洗錢交織，所謂的“贏錢秘籍”和“高額回報”全是騙局。警惕關聯陷阱：切勿輕信“高薪招聘”、“包機票食宿”等虛假誘惑，防範陷入非法勞務或被限制人身自由。三、共同打擊犯罪，歡迎積極舉報中國公安部已開通打擊治理跨境賭博綜合舉報平臺。如您掌握中國公民在境外經營賭場、組織招攬中國公民赴境外賭博或參與網路賭博的線索，請及時透過撥打國內110渠道進行舉報。

【IEA Says Gas Investment To Hit 10-Year High This Year; Oil Investment May Fall For Third Straight Year】The International Energy Agency (IEA) said in a report that global investment in gas projects is expected to rise by more than 10% this year to $330 billion, a 10-year high, while upstream oil investment is set to fall for a third consecutive year. With the Iran war disrupting global energy markets, energy firms are accelerating investment in other regions and increasing spending on renewables, liquefied natural gas and coal to bolster supply security. In its 2026 Global Energy Investment Report, the IEA said that despite Middle East turmoil, energy-sector capital spending in 2026 is expected to grow 5% to $3.4 trillion, of which $2.2 trillion will be allocated to renewables, storage, grids and low-emission fuels. Oil-supply investment will be below $500 billion. Gas investment growth is driven mainly by U.S. LNG projects, but the current crisis has made Asian importers more cautious about reliance on gas. Coal investment will hit a 14-year high at $180 billion. Nuclear investment is recovering, with spending this year expected to reach $80 billion. The IEA expects Middle East oil-and-gas investment in 2026 to decline about 1%, citing infrastructure damage, revenue losses and production disruptions that have weakened capital-deployment capacity.

【Paul Chan Says Hong Kong Investment Management Company Building 'Patient Capital' Ecosystem To Crowd In Market Funds】Paul Chan, Financial Secretary of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, said today at the 2026 Hong Kong Sci‑Tech Seminar that Hong Kong must build the full financing and financial‑services chain tightly integrated with the sci‑tech sector. He said the Hong Kong equity market has performed strongly over the past two years and many mainland sci‑tech firms view Hong Kong as their first choice for fundraising and overseas expansion. He added that is only the back end of financing; Hong Kong must deploy smaller‑ticket capital, fund earlier stages, and invest in hard technology, and support emerging and future industries that require large up‑front investment, carry high risk, and have long return cycles. To that end, he said the government is vigorously developing a 'patient capital' ecosystem through Hong Kong Investment Management Company to guide and crowd in market funds. He said the 'financial+' vision is not only rooted in China but oriented to Asia and intended to radiate globally, and that the goal is to make global sci‑tech companies willing to come to Hong Kong to grow and scale.

Aussie Dollar Hits 6-Week Low — The Australian dollar weakened to around $0.71, hitting a six-week low as weak household demand reinforced expectations that monetary tightening is nearing its end. Data showed household spending fell a sharper-than-expected 1.1% in April as consumers cut back on travel, clothing, and food, with higher fuel costs and geopolitical uncertainty weighing on confidence. The decline added to signs that restrictive monetary policy is cooling demand, even as business investment surged 6.5% in Q1, driven largely by imported data equipment. Markets now widely expect the Reserve Bank to keep rates unchanged at 4.35% in June, while the odds of an August hike has more than halved to 40%. Earlier inflation data also supported the shift in sentiment, with headline CPI easing to 0.4% in April and annual inflation slowing to 4.2%, helped partly by fuel tax relief. However, underlying inflation remained elevated at 3.4%, still above the RBA’s target range.

Palm Oil Extends Gains After Holiday Break — Malaysian palm oil futures rose for a second straight session, hovering above MYR 4,500 per tonne as trading resumed after a holiday break. Support came from a weaker ringgit, concerns over softer Malaysian output, and firmer edible oils in Dalian and Chicago markets. Simultaneously, crude oil prices surged as Washington–Tehran tensions escalated, despite ongoing peace talks, adding upside support to palm oil through its biodiesel link. Meanwhile, top producer Indonesia plans to channel key commodity exports, including palm oil, through a state-run firm starting in September, a move that could benefit Malaysian palm oil shipments. However, gains were capped by an uncertain demand outlook from India, the world's largest importer, after the country’s palm oil imports plunged 26% in April to a four-month low. Weak export demand also weighed, with cargo surveyors noting that Malaysian palm oil exports during May 1–25 fell between 14.5% and 18.0% from the same period in April.

【何小鵬判斷2027年是機器人量產元年】小鵬集團董事長何小鵬在訪談中表示，高等級人形機器人的商業化量產元年很可能在2027年。他認為，機器人是“物理AI”的核心載體，其軟體價值天然很高，一旦能力突破，規模化速度可能遠超汽車。小鵬選擇了最像人的通用人形機器人這條艱難道路，併為此重組了團隊，聚焦於用AI而非傳統軟體工程來驅動機器人的大腦和運動控制。何小鵬預測，從2027年開始，物理AI將像數字AI一樣，開始對眾多崗位產生巨大幫助甚至一定程度的取代。

South Korean Won Weakens on Risk-Off Flows — The South Korean won weakened to around 1,510 per dollar, reversing gains from the previous session, pressured by a firmer US dollar as geopolitical uncertainty and rising oil prices. Market sentiment was weighed by ongoing volatility around US-Iran negotiations, with President Donald Trump saying Washington remained “not satisfied” with talks, while conflicting reports on a possible reopening of the Strait of Hormuz added to uncertainty. Brent crude’s move back toward $96 per barrel further pressured the won, given Korea’s high energy import dependence and sensitivity to external price shocks. Meanwhile, domestic policy signals offered only partial offset, as the Bank of Korea kept its policy rate unchanged at 2.5% for an eighth straight meeting. While the central bank upgraded its growth outlook on stronger semiconductor exports, it also flagged persistent inflation and currency weakness risks, reinforcing expectations for a cautious policy stance going forward.

【香港特區政府歡迎司法機構設立香港國際商事法庭】香港特區政府今日（28日）歡迎和支援司法機構宣佈將設立香港國際商事法庭，專門審理重大的跨境國際商事糾紛，標誌著香港法治體系發展邁向新里程。特區政府全力支援和配合香港國際商事法庭的籌備工作及相關安排。 香港特區行政長官李家超表示，國家“十五五”規劃明確提出加快涉外法治體系和能力建設，健全國際商事調解、仲裁、訴訟等機制，支援香港鞏固提升國際金融、航運、貿易中心和國際航空樞紐地位，深化國際法律及解決爭議服務中心建設。香港特區是全國唯一實行普通法的司法管轄區，以普通法為基礎的香港商業經貿法律與國際商事規則連線，一直深受國際商界和投資者信任。設立香港國際商事法庭，充分體現香港在“一國兩制”下發揮背靠祖國、聯通世界的獨特優勢，為國家高水平對外開放貢獻新的更大力量，同時進一步推動國際商事規則發展。

【美國NASA局長預計最早2030年代初在月球上建成永久基地】美國國家航空航天局（NASA）局長Jared Isaacman表示，將從2027年開始建造月球基地，並計劃大概每月進行一次機器人著陸；到2030年代初，宇航員有可能在月球表面一次生活數月。Isaacman當地時間週三接受採訪時表示，到2028年“阿爾忒彌斯”4號宇航員著陸時，“月球基地的一些基礎設施將已經為他們準備就緒”。NASA已選擇藍色起源以及其他承包商負責開發著陸器和月球車，這是為載人任務奠定基礎的三階段戰略的一部分。Isaacman說，這種方法標誌著NASA迴歸其在1960年代水星計劃、雙子座計劃和阿波羅計劃時期採用的策略。該機構不會在今天就敲定月球基礎設施的設計方案，而是會利用首批著陸任務來指導決策，確定哪些硬體最有效。他表示，這一階段的重點將是“生存科學”。第二階段將持續到2030年代初，屆時將部署更重型的裝置，並將宇航員在月球上的停留時間從幾天延長到可能數週。第三階段設想採用類似於國際空間站的輪換制度，宇航員將在月球上駐留數月。

European Gas Prices Rise — European natural gas futures rose to around €47.1 per megawatt hour, recouping part of the previous session’s losses amid continued lack of any concrete resolution to the Middle East conflict despite recent optimism. Iranian media reported progress on a draft deal aimed at ending the war, though the White House later dismissed the claim as “a complete fabrication.” An agreement between the two sides could pave the way for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, which has remained largely closed for three months now. Continued disruption has heightened concerns that Europe may face difficulties replenishing inventories ahead of winter, with current storage levels at around 38%, well below the five-year average of more than 50% for this period. Adding to demand-side pressures, Europe is experiencing its first major heatwave of the season, with record temperatures forecast in cities such as London, Paris, and Madrid.

【Japan Plans Transition Bonds To Finance Sanae Takaichi Investment Plan】Japan Cabinet Secretary KIHARA said on Thursday Japan plans to use transition bonds to finance Sanae Takaichi's investment plan. KIHARA said, "Japan has in the past used transition bonds backed by future revenues to implement multi-year budget measures." He added that a similar mechanism had previously been used to fund corporate green-technology transitions and said the government will "further expand such measures and push for a stronger economy." Transition bonds are intended to fill temporary funding gaps on the premise of future-secured revenue streams; the Finance Ministry classifies them separately from deficit-covering bonds. The proposal comes as Japanese bond-market concern over the fiscal outlook continues to mount. Earlier this month, 10-year JGB yields rose to their highest level since 1996 amid market worries that a Takaichi government would favour an expansionary fiscal stance. The transition-bond plan appears aimed at avoiding further market concern over large-scale issuance of deficit-financing bonds, but market doubts about its repayment scheme could still pressure the bond market.

China to Accept Coffee Bean Shipments from 53 African Countries — China will allow eligible coffee bean imports from all 53 African countries with diplomatic ties to enter its market starting July 20, 2026, the General Administration of Customs (GAC) announced. Coffee beans become the second African agricultural product, after dried chilies, to gain full quarantine access to China, highlighting deeper agricultural trade ties between China and Africa. Major African producers such as Ethiopia and Burundi have already secured export access, while Mauritius, Angola, Togo, Guinea, Liberia, and Sao Tome and Principe have submitted applications.

Washington and Tehran also remained divided over major issues, including Iran’s insistence on retaining control of the Strait of Hormuz and preserving its nuclear program. Meanwhile, Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said on Thursday that reducing inflation remains his top priority, emphasizing that consumer prices are still too high even as the US labor market remains relatively strong. Investors are now awaiting the latest PCE price index report, the Federal Reserve’s preferred inflation gauge, for additional clues on the direction of monetary policy. Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 50% probability of a Fed rate hike by December.

Traders attempted to maintain the upward momentum, supported by the electronic technology sector, which rose 0.9%. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which accounts for more than 40% of the market’s total value, advanced 2.0%, while Hon Hai Precision Industry gained 2.1%. 【ECB Chief Economist: Iran War Will Have Lasting Impact On Inf】ECB chief economist LANE said on Thursday that even if the Middle East conflict is resolved quickly, the resulting energy shock could have a lasting impact on inf. While oil prices have historically fallen back to prior levels after a sharp spike, the current episode may differ because countries are rebuilding inventories or adjusting energy mixes, leaving energy costs elevated. LANE said: "Global oil supply fell quite rapidly and sharply overnight, a gap that had previously been masked by inventories. Even if the initial energy shock begins to fade, second‑round effects will persist for some time." He added that policy lessons from past energy shocks include that rising energy costs can abruptly push up inf and trigger "various non‑linear" mechanisms that broaden price increases. "But this is different from the non‑linear case four years ago," he said, referring to the Ukraine war, when supply disruptions combined with strong demand from the post‑COVID restart to lift inf. LANE said central banks must acknowledge any major shock and its potential impact on inf, but should avoid overreacting when setting monetary policy.

Bitcoin Hits Five-Week Low — Bitcoin fell to around $74,000 in late May, reaching its lowest level in over five weeks, coinciding with signs of cooling institutional demand. US spot-Bitcoin ETFs have posted roughly $1 billion in net outflows so far this month, snapping a two-month streak of inflows. Bitcoin’s implied volatility also dropped to a nine-month low, as muted trading activity and waning speculative interest reduced demand for downside protection in the options market. Meanwhile, risk appetite was further dampened by ongoing Middle East uncertainty, as renewed hostilities have raised doubts over the viability of a lasting agreement despite continued negotiations. Markets also remained focused on the legislative breakthrough for the crypto market, as the Clarity Act cleared the Senate Banking Committee earlier this month, though analysts note that the bill still faces an uncertain path ahead.

Meanwhile, President Donald Trump said he was “not satisfied” with the progress of negotiations and rejected reports suggesting Iran and Oman could jointly oversee shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Investors are now focused on the upcoming PCE price index release, the Federal Reserve’s preferred inflation measure, for further guidance on the outlook for US interest rates. Markets are currently pricing in roughly a 50% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike by December.

Corn Prices Hit 5-Week Low — Corn futures fell to around $4.5 per bushel, hitting a five-week low as uncertainty over global trade and geopolitical developments weighed on prices. A potential US–Iran peace deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and restore flows of fuel and fertilizers critical for crop production is seen as supportive for agricultural supply, potentially boosting global grain output. However, crude oil prices rebounded on reports of fresh US strikes in southern Iran, reinforcing biofuel-related demand. Elsewhere, doubts over a US–China trade agreement added pressure. While the US administration said China had agreed to purchase at least $17 billion in US agricultural goods annually through 2028 following Trump–Xi talks in Beijing, China’s Commerce Ministry described the arrangement only as a “guiding target” to expand trade, without confirming the figure. USDA data indicates that a recovery in Chinese corn imports would mark a notable shift after nearly two years of subdued buying.

New Zealand Sees Narrower 2025/26 Budget Gap — New Zealand on Thursday forecast a budget deficit of NZ$15.06 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, narrower than the NZ$16.93 billion deficit projected in its half-year fiscal update in December, as Reuters reported. Net debt excluding advances was forecast to peak at 46.1% of gross domestic product in 2027/28, down from the December estimates of 46.9% of GDP in 2027/28 and 2028/29. For 2025/26, net debt is estimated at 42.4% of GDP, compared with the December forecast of 43.3%. Meanwhile, GDP growth for 2026/27 is forecast at 2.3%, slightly below the December estimate of 2.4%.

【GOOLSBEE: AI Productivity Expectations, Rising Oil Could Force Central Banks To Hike】Chicago Fed President GOOLSBEE on Thursday reinforced his warning that growing market expectations of AI-driven productivity gains could lift inf and prompt the Federal Reserve and other central banks to tighten policy. GOOLSBEE said: “The stronger the hype about future productivity, the higher rates may need to be to prevent the economy from overheating. More importantly, facing short-term supply shocks — whether from oil prices, supply‑chain disruptions or other factors — will make the problem worse.” He said these remarks expand on a view he first aired publicly earlier this month, when he challenged the notion that AI will be disinflationary and therefore create scope for central-bank rate cuts — a view embraced by many Trump administration officials and by the Fed’s new chair Woshe. GOOLSBEE noted that in the 1990s broader computer adoption unexpectedly raised US productivity and supported rapid growth without triggering inf, but warned that if productivity gains are already priced into market expectations the dynamics change: markets may front‑load spending and push up prices before real productivity gains materialize.

Platinum Hits 1-Month Low — Platinum futures slipped to around $1,900 per ounce, hitting a four-week low, as uncertainty over diplomatic progress in the Middle East kept inflation risks and expectations of prolonged high interest rates in focus. Key sticking points remain, including Iran’s demand to retain control over the Strait of Hormuz and its nuclear program, while the US continues to reject sanctions relief and what it views as an unfavorable agreement. Even if negotiations progress, elevated energy prices are likely to keep inflation under pressure and support the case for interest rates remaining higher for longer. Meanwhile, the platinum market remains structurally tight, with the World Platinum Investment Council projecting a fourth consecutive annual supply deficit in 2026. Automotive demand also remains broadly resilient, supported by hybrid vehicle growth and tighter emissions standards, while jewelry consumption weakens under higher prices, particularly in China.

【ZELENSKIY Writes To TRUMP And US Congress Seeking Help To Boost Missile Defense】On the evening of May 27 local time, Ukrainian President ZELENSKIY said in a video statement he had written to U.S. President TRUMP and the U.S. Congress, urging prompt U.S. assistance to strengthen Ukraine's ballistic missile defence capability. He said it is rare for foreign leaders to write both the president and Congress, underlining the urgency of the situation, and argued Ukraine must further bolster its missile-defence capacity to pave the way for diplomacy and advance the peace process. The letter, he said, urgently requests more Patriot PAC-3 interceptors and other air-defense systems to counter Russian ballistic-missile strikes. ZELENSKIY wrote that U.S. weapons stocks have been depleted by a war with Iran, producing a "dangerous shortfall" in military aid bound for Ukraine. He added Ukraine has raised its drone-interception rate to above 90%, and that during the US–Israel–Iran conflict Ukrainian experts helped Gulf states strengthen air defences and even assisted U.S. military bases in the Middle East. AP said this was meant to signal Ukraine has "reciprocated" for U.S. security. ZELENSKIY wrote Ukraine currently cannot produce missile-defence systems domestically and is "almost completely dependent on the United States" in this area.

South Korea’s 10Y Yield Rises After BoK Decision — South Korea’s 10-year government bond yield rose to around 4.16% in late May, moving back toward its highest level since November 2023, after the central bank held rates steady but signaled a more hawkish tilt. The Bank of Korea raised its inflation outlook for this year to 2.7%, up from 2.2% in February, citing higher energy costs following disruptions linked to the Iran conflict. It also lifted its 2026 growth forecast to 2.6% from 2%, reflecting a stronger-than-expected Q1 rebound driven by booming global demand tied to artificial intelligence. Against this backdrop, the central bank’s dot plot for policy rates six months ahead showed a clear hawkish shift, with two members projecting rates as high as 3.25% in risk scenarios. Most projections clustered around 3%, pointing to expectations of roughly two additional rate hikes over the coming half year.

Palladium Trades Below $1,400 — Palladium futures fell below $1,400 per ounce, easing after a brief period of stabilization as investors assessed the inflationary impact of rising energy prices and growing expectations that interest rates may remain elevated for longer. Renewed US military strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz deepened concerns over global energy supply disruptions, pushing Brent crude up 2% to $96.15 per barrel and reinforcing expectations that major central banks may delay monetary easing. A stronger US dollar and higher Treasury yield outlook also weighed on sentiment toward non-yielding precious metals. Still, palladium continued to draw support from tight supply conditions, as ongoing production challenges in South Africa and uncertainty surrounding Russian exports kept supply concerns elevated. Despite recent weakness, palladium prices remain 42.87% higher than a year ago, although they have fallen 6.19% over the past month.

China Stocks Remain Under Pressure — The Shanghai Composite fell 0.3% to 4,080 on Thursday, marking its third straight decline, while the Shenzhen Component dropped 0.6% to 15,644 for a second consecutive session, as lingering uncertainty over a potential US-Iran deal continued to dampen sentiment. The US confirmed defensive airstrikes on an Iranian military site, while key issues in US-Iran negotiations such as Tehran's control of the Strait of Hormuz and its nuclear program remain unresolved. Domestically, concerns over weakening Chinese fuel demand resurfaced as disruptions to oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz added pressure to energy markets. According to London-based consultancy Energy Aspects Ltd., China’s crude oil imports are on track to average 10.9 million barrels per day this year, the lowest since 2022. Technology stocks led the decline, with Hygon Information Technology (-7.1%), Cambricon Technologies (-5%), NAURA Technology (-3.5%), and Victory Giant Technology (-3.5%) posting sharp losses.

New Zealand Dollar Near 2-Week High — The New Zealand dollar traded near a two-week high at around $0.589 on Thursday, after RBNZ Governor Anna Breman said the cash rate may need to rise as inflationary pressures intensify. Her remarks reinforced the hawkish tone struck by the central bank when it kept interest rates unchanged the previous day. Updated projections from the RBNZ indicate at least two 25-basis-point rate hikes before year-end. Higher oil prices have lifted the inflation outlook, now projected to peak at 4.3% in the third quarter, well above the RBNZ’s 1-3% target range. The central bank also revised its economic growth forecasts lower. Breman noted that policymakers are closely monitoring the extent to which weaker demand, driven by rising costs and persistent inflation, is acting to ease broader price pressures across the economy, a key factor in assessing the future path of rates. She added that the central bank remains committed to returning inflation to its target.

【Goldman Cuts Kuaishou PT 5%, Keeps Buy; Keling Seen As Growth Highlight】Goldman Sachs said in a report it cut Kuaishou (01024.HK) PT by 5.4%, to HK$60 from HK$74, and maintained a "Buy" rating. The bank lowered its revenue forecasts for 2026–2028 by 2%–0% and trimmed 2026–2028 net profit estimates by 4%–7% to reflect the company’s additional AI-related investments. Kuaishou’s reported Q1 2026 results were broadly in line with expectations: core advertising revenue rose 9% YoY, but operating profit fell 15%, weighed by AI investment and other factors. A highlight was Kuaishou unit Keling, whose annual recurring revenue (ARR) as of end-March approached US$500 mln and which sustained growth momentum into Q2 2026. Goldman said Kuaishou, as a stable, steadily growing major video platform, has buybacks/dividends totaling close to 4%, which should support the current share price; Keling’s ARR surge and any potential spin-off could alter Kuaishou’s overall strategic trajectory.

【Nomura: Middle East Risk May Disrupt BOJ Rate-Hike Path】Swap market pricing shows traders put the probability of a BOJ rate hike at about 75% for June and 92% for July. Michio Saito of Nomura Capital Markets Research Institute said the Iran war could push oil higher and weigh on energy-importing Japan, making the BOJ more cautious about tightening. Saito, who served until 2023 as a senior bond policy official at Japan’s Ministry of Finance, said, “The timing for a rate hike has actually arrived, or at least is very close… but I am not sure the BOJ policy board’s path to a hike will be smooth.” He added that JGB yields may have risen excessively amid market concerns about inflation and a possible expansion of government fiscal spending. Japan’s 10-year government bond yield briefly rose to 2.8% on May 18, its highest since 1996; Saito said that level is currently too high relative to other parts of the JGB curve and that a reasonable range for the 10-year is about 2.0%–2.5%. He warned that if the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, market worries over oil and LNG supply would intensify and, for Japan, “the risk is no longer just higher prices; economic activity itself could stall.”

【Beijing Calls For Stronger Debt Management, More Mid- to Long-Term Credit And Greater Use Of REITs】The Beijing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China and the Beijing Municipal People’s Government issued implementation opinions on promoting high‑quality urban development, proposing a series of financing and investment reforms. Measures include establishing a sustainable investment-and-financing system for city construction and operation; deepening investment approval reform and strengthening whole‑process management of government investment; optimizing implementation of “two‑heavy” construction projects and increasing the share of spending on livelihood and safety; and strengthening government debt management. The document calls for improving public‑private partnership (PPP) models, developing patient capital to spur investment, and bolstering mid‑ to long‑term credit supply by encouraging insurance, trust and other institutions to provide financial services and by making full use of real estate investment trusts (REITs) and similar products. It also proposes an infrastructure investment–pricing–subsidy linkage mechanism and tighter cost coordination.

【Beijing: Strengthen Trillion-Yuan Industry Clusters In Next-Generation IT, Pharmaceuticals And Healthcare】The CPC Beijing Municipal Committee and the Beijing Municipal Government issued Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Urban Development, saying technological innovation should lead new-quality productive forces. The document calls for accelerating construction of Zhongguancun into a world-leading science park, deepening the "Science+City" model and fostering a globally competitive innovation ecosystem. It mandates coordinated development of the "Three Cities and One Zone," strengthening Zhongguancun Science City’s role as a source of technological and industrial innovation, leveraging Huairou Science City’s concentration of major scientific infrastructure, and driving capacity upgrades in priority areas of the Future Science City. It supports innovative industrial-cluster demonstration zones in receiving innovation outputs and industrial resources. The plan directs maintaining an appropriate share of advanced manufacturing and strengthening trillion-yuan industry clusters in next-generation information technology, pharmaceuticals and healthcare. It also calls for expanding advantages in technology, financial and commercial services, deepening "two-industry integration," and optimizing and bolstering the headquarters economy.

It instructs deepening comprehensive reform pilots for market‑based allocation of production factors; facilitating the relocation of landmark projects to Xiong'an New Area and promoting coordinated advancement of the “two wings.” The document directs active promotion of the Beijing (Beijing‑Tianjin‑Hebei) international science and technology innovation center to raise the regional conversion efficiency and share of innovation outcomes. Australia Capital Spending Rises Faster in Q1 — Total new capital expenditure in Australia jumped 6.5% quarter-on-quarter in the first quarter of 2026, accelerating from an upwardly revised 0.7% increase in the previous quarter and far exceeding market expectations for a 1.0% rise. Investment in equipment, plant, and machinery jumped 18.1%, rebounding sharply from a 1.3% decline previously, largely driven by renewed growth in non-mining industries (20.1% vs -1.2% in Q4). Meanwhile, spending on buildings and infrastructure fell 3.8%, reversing a 2.5% increase, mainly due to lower non-mining investment (-4.3% vs 4.4%). Regionally, capital spending rose strongly in New South Wales (22.1%) and Victoria (12.7%), while South Australia posted a modest gain of 0.2%. In contrast, investment in the Northern Territory plunged 39.8%, with declines also recorded in Queensland (-3.0%), Western Australia (-4.3%), Tasmania (-8.0%), and the Australian Capital Territory (-9.4%). On an annual basis, private capex increased 14.6%.

【“和平委員會”賬戶“零收入” 另設“小金庫”】美國總統特朗普今年1月22日高調啟動“和平委員會”，稱將推動巴勒斯坦加沙地帶重建。然而，據《金融時報》27日援引多名知情人士的話披露，4個多月來，“和平委員會”在世界銀行開設的賬戶資金為零，而且另設了一個“小金庫”。特朗普先前表示，“和平委員會”成員計劃提供70億美元，美國將捐款100億美元。但一名知情人士說，“和平委員會”在世界銀行的賬戶至今“存入的美元為零”。同時，“和平委員會”在美國摩根大通銀行設立一個賬戶。“和平委員會”一名官員證實，包括世界銀行賬戶在內，有“多種途徑”接受捐款，但“目前捐款方選擇使用”世行以外的途徑。世行必須向捐款方和“和平委員會”成員報告賬戶資金情況，但設在摩根大通的賬戶則不受獨立的透明性監管。那名“和平委員會”官員表示，將在“合適的時間”向“和平委員會”的創始執行委員會報告財務情況。這一執行委員會成員多數是特朗普政府的官員，包括國務卿魯比奧。（新華社）

【U.S. FAA Orders SpaceX To Investigate Starship Booster Accident】According to The Hill, the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Wednesday ordered SpaceX to investigate the cause of a Super Heavy booster losing control and falling into the Gulf of Mexico during a test flight last week. After assessing the 12th Starship launch, the FAA said the launch "experienced an accident" and that the failure originated with the Super Heavy booster, which fell into the Gulf during its return following stage separation. The FAA added there are no reports of injuries or property damage and said it will oversee the company-led investigation; Starship may not fly again until the FAA approves SpaceX's final investigation report and any corrective measures.

Australia Plant Machinery Capex Rises the Most Since 1996 — Private new capital expenditure on equipment, plant, and machinery in Australia climbed by 18.1% qoq in the first quarter of 2026, rebounding sharply from a downwardly revised 1.3% fall in the previous quarter. This also marked the strongest growth since March 1996, largely driven by non-mining business investments, which recorded an 8.8% increase (vs 1.3% in Q4 2025), while mining-related equipment spending (0% vs -0.9%) was relatively unchanged. Information media and telecommunications recorded the largest industry rise, up 96.1%, reaching a new record level. “The lift in investment was the result of investment in data centre equipment, specifically server racks and processing equipment, significantly boosting overall investment figures”, said Tom Lay, Head of Business Statistics at the ABS. On an annual basis, investment in equipment, plant, and machinery surged by 31%, the sharpest since December 1994 and accelerating from an upwardly revised 9.8% rise in the prior period.

Australia Personal Spending Falls for First Time in 4 Months — Household spending in Australia dropped 1.1% mom in April 2026, reversing a 1.6% rise in the previous month and marking the first contraction since December. Spending decreased for food (-1.3% vs 1.7% in March), clothing (-2.2% vs 0.9%), furnishings and household equipment (-0.1% vs 1.5%), transport (-4.7% vs 5.4%), recreation (-0.2% vs 1.2%), and miscellaneous goods and services (-1.0% vs 1.4%). In contrast, outlays rose for alcoholic drinks and tobacco (0.3% vs -0.4%), health (0.5% vs 0.4% ), and hotels, cafes, and restaurants (0.5% vs -0.9%). Regionally, spending declined in New South Wales (-0.8%), Victoria (-1.5%), Queensland (-1.0%), South Australia (-1.2%), and Western Australia (-1.9%). In contrast, spending rose in Tasmania (0.3%) and the Northern Territory (0.4%), while remaining unchanged in the Australian Capital Territory. On an annual basis, household spending increased 4.9%, easing from a 6.2% gain in March, which had marked the fastest growth pace since September 2023.

South Korean Shares Edge Lower From Record High — The benchmark KOSPI edged down 0.6% to around 8,180 on Thursday, easing from record highs amid uncertainty surrounding US-Iran negotiations. Sentiment weakened after US President Donald Trump said Washington was still “not satisfied” with ongoing talks, while the White House denied reports suggesting progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude climbed back toward $96 per barrel, weighing on risk appetite. Technology shares retreated after leading recent gains, with Samsung Electronics (-1.1%) moving lower alongside SK Square (-2.2%), HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (-2.7%), and Hanwha Aerospace (-3.0%). Meanwhile, broader sentiment remained supported by optimism over South Korea’s semiconductor sector after the Bank of Korea raised its 2026 growth forecast to 2.6% from 2.0%, citing robust chip-driven exports. The central bank also kept interest rates unchanged for an eighth straight meeting while highlighting persistent inflation and currency risks.

【ANZ: AI Demand Boosts Copper; Middle East Tensions And Tariff Risk Cap Base Metals】Copper rose in Asian early trade, with LME three-month copper up 0.2% to $13,554/ton. ANZ research analysts said in a report that the global AI-driven demand surge has shifted market expectations for demand more positively, benefiting copper. They highlighted rising copper use in Australian power infrastructure — including transmission lines and electrical equipment — as reinforcing the bullish case for copper. Overall base metals were mixed as signs of difficult US-Iran peace talks damped sentiment and suggested the Middle East conflict may not end soon. ANZ also noted increased US copper imports ahead of potential tariff measures, which has raised concerns about tightening global supply.

【SEMI Predicts Glass Substrates Will Enter Early Production Around 2028】The global semiconductor industry association SEMI said in its latest forecast that, driven by rising demand from artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing (HPC), glass substrates are expected to enter early production around 2028. SEMI said initial production will target specific high-performance applications and only later expand into broader, more complex semiconductor packaging structures. The association projects the glass substrate market to grow at a 67.2% CAGR from 2028 through 2040.

【China's Agricultural Products And Food Ingredients Consumption Market Size Up 3.19% YoY In Q1】Today the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing (CFLP) said China’s agricultural products and food ingredients supply-chain sector in Q1 displayed a favorable trend of steady progress and improved quality and efficiency, shifting from volume-driven expansion to a value-creation phase. Consumption market size was about 2.6 trillion yuan in Q1, up 3.19% YoY, with the market demand base remaining broadly stable. The retail end accounted for roughly 2.0 trillion yuan and continued to dominate; the catering (restaurant) end grew more than 4.2% YoY and served as an important engine of consumption growth.

【一季度我國農產品與食材消費市場規模同比增長3.19%】記者今天從中國物流與採購聯合會瞭解到，一季度我國農產品與食材供應鏈行業，整體呈現穩中有進、提質增效的良好態勢，正從“放量增長”轉向“價值創造”的全新階段。今年一季度，我國農產品與食材消費市場規模約2.6萬億元，同比增長3.19%，市場需求基本盤保持穩固。其中，零售端市場規模約2萬億元，繼續佔據主導地位；餐飲端增速超過4.2%，成為拉動農產品與食材消費增長的重要引擎。

【US Media: Trump Administration Plans Equity Stakes In Drone Firms To Boost Domestic Output】The Wall Street Journal, citing people familiar with the matter, reports the Trump administration is advancing financing agreements with a group of drone companies as part of efforts to raise US domestic capacity and lower costs. The potential deals, after months of talks, involve a range of private drone firms and the PENTAGON, and discussions have included the Strategic Capital Office, a loan vehicle set up under the Biden administration to fund companies deemed critical to national-security supply chains. Some agreements could combine debt financing and equity investments, which would result in the US government taking partial ownership stakes in the companies, sources said. Companies the PENTAGON has listed as potential funding candidates include Performance Drone Works, which won a US Army contract to supply reconnaissance drones; drone parts supplier Unusual Machines, whose shareholder and advisory-board member is Donald Trump Jr.; and Neros Technologies, a Sequoia-backed startup developing small first-person-view (FPV) drones. A 2025 estimate cited by the report says the US can currently produce at most about 100,000 drones a year; by comparison, Ukraine produced roughly 4 million last year. The drone industry has long criticized the PENTAGON for insufficient procurement levels, saying shortfalls have left it unable to finance future capacity expansion.

【韓國央行維持利率不變  上調增長預期】韓國央行在行長申鉉松主持的首次會議上維持利率不變，但因上調了增長和通脹預期，為政策收緊敞開了大門。韓國央行週四將其基準七天期回購利率維持在2.50%不變，這標誌著該行連續第八次會議未作調整。媒體調查的25位經濟學家中，有24位此前預測5月份利率將維持不變。多數經濟學家預計，鑑於經濟增長和通脹面臨上行風險，韓國央行未來幾個月將採取更偏緊縮的立場。許多人預計韓國央行將在第三季度加息，最早可能在7月份。他們指出，在強勁晶片出口的推動下，韓國第一季度經濟增長強勁，此外，在中東緊張局勢之際，油價上漲也推高了通脹。該央行週四上調了對這個亞洲第四大經濟體的增長預期。該行目前預計2026年國內生產總值(GDP)將增長2.6%，高於2月份預測的2.0%。該行還預計，2027年該國經濟將增長2.1%，而此前的預估值為1.8%。該行預測今年的平均通脹率為2.7%，明年為2.3%。相比之下，該行先前對2026年和2027年的通脹率預測分別為2.2%和2.0%。

Silver Holds Losses on US-Iran Deadlock — Silver traded near $74 an ounce on Thursday after a sharp decline in the previous session, as ongoing uncertainty surrounding US-Iran peace negotiations kept concerns over inflation and prolonged high interest rates firmly in focus. Key disagreements remain unresolved, including Tehran’s insistence on maintaining control of the Strait of Hormuz and preserving its nuclear program. President Donald Trump also reiterated that the US would not agree to what he called a bad deal and rejected easing sanctions on Iran despite Tehran’s demands for financial relief and an end to attacks. Even if both sides move closer to a deal, elevated energy prices are still expected to fuel inflationary pressures and encourage central banks to keep interest rates higher for longer, rather than proceed with the rate cuts. Silver is currently down about 20% since the conflict began.

【韓國央行維持基準利率不變 政策前景仍存不確定性】韓國央行週四維持基準利率不變，在政策制定者權衡油價上漲帶來的通脹壓力與更廣泛經濟前景的不確定性之際，繼續保持審慎立場。韓國央行將7天回購利率維持在2.5%，延續了自去年7月以來的按兵不動態勢 —— 此前在2024年10月至2025年5月期間，該行曾四次降息。這一決定符合媒體調查的23位經濟學家中22人的預期，其餘1人則預測將加息25個基點。此次會議是行長申鉉松主持的首場政策會議，也是新任理事Kim Jinill首次參與的會議。Kim Jinill曾任美聯儲經濟學家，市場普遍認為其立場比前任Shin Sung Hwan更為鷹派。申行長計劃於週四晚些時候向記者通報情況，預計將詳細闡述政策前景，以及理事會對半導體行業和國內住房市場狀況的評估。

【天津市人民政府與四家央企分別簽署戰略合作協議】據天津日報，5月27日，天津市人民政府與中國聯合網路通訊集團有限公司、中國行動通訊集團有限公司、中國汽車技術研究中心有限公司、中國檢驗認證（集團）有限公司分別簽署戰略合作協議。其中，天津市與中國聯通將協同佈局新型基礎設施建設與智算基地，重點培育多維度AI行業應用場景，拓展資料流通場景，全面賦能產業數智轉型，深化數字政府建設合作，推動科教醫衛領域數智升級。天津市與中國中檢簽署的戰略合作協議將圍繞產業升級、口岸建設、綠色低碳、城市安全、人才培育等多領域開展，助力天津打造檢驗檢測服務高地。
【伊朗官員說不會因美國“口頭威脅”而退讓】伊朗伊斯蘭議會國家安全委員會主席28日凌晨在社交媒體上發文說，伊朗不會因美國總統特朗普的“口頭威脅”而退讓，不會放棄其劃定的紅線，即擁有鈾濃縮權利及濃縮鈾庫存、對霍爾木茲海峽的管轄權，以及解除對伊制裁。特朗普於美國東部時間27日在白宮舉行的內閣會議上說，美國同伊朗尚未達成協議，美方對此“不滿意”。（新華社）

【摩根士丹利：快手業績超預期 AI產品可靈的貢獻抵消了核心業務疲弱】摩根士丹利稱，快手一季度業績超預期，主要得益於人工智慧平臺可靈的收入和其他收益的增長；可靈的增量貢獻對沖了核心業務的疲弱。分析師Yang Liu等人在報告中表示，將可靈2026年底的年度經常性收入(ARR)預期從8.4億美元上調至10億美元。截至3月底，可靈ARR接近5億美元，而該行之前的預期僅為3.8億美元。但在核心業務拖累下，將快手2026至2028年的每股收益分別下調5%、1%和2%。可靈潛在的分拆上市可能會釋放巨大價值，這一觀點保持不變。

South Korea Holds Key Rate Steady — The Bank of Korea (BoK) kept its policy rate unchanged at 2.5% at its May 2026 meeting, in line with expectations and marking the eighth consecutive hold, even as it remains in an easing cycle. Policymakers maintained a cautious stance, balancing rising inflationary pressures from higher oil prices against lingering uncertainty over the broader economic outlook. It was also the first policy meeting chaired by new Governor Shin Hyun-song, who took office last month.

【Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er Holds Talks With Geely Chairman Li Shufu】Tianjin Daily reported that on May 27 Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er held talks with Geely Holding Group Chairman Li Shufu and his delegation. 【Huatai Securities: AI Chain And Energy Continue To Drive Industrial Corporate Profit Upswing】Huatai Securities said in a research note that April industrial enterprise profit growth accelerated to 24.7% from March's 15.8%, driven by improved price indicators that supported profit repair, and that the rebound in inf showed higher elasticity. It warned that mid- and downstream firms outside the AI chain saw marginal profit weakening, signaling intensifying cost-side pressure. April oil price gains continued to lift petroleum processing and chemical product profits, while strong global AI investment demand kept the electronic computer sector leading profit and revenue growth; other mid-/downstream sectors' profit growth remained weak. Both volume and price contributed to the overall profit recovery: revenue growth rose to 5.8% in April from 4.5% in March, and seasonally adjusted profit margin edged up to 5.8% from 5.7% in March. Sector divergence widened: upstream industries' contribution to aggregate profit growth increased by 2.1 ppts from March's 3.8 ppts to 5.9 ppts. Within mid-/downstream, computer and communications contributed 6.8 ppts, non-ferrous smelting 4.7 ppts and chemical products 6.1 ppts; the three together contributed roughly 17.5 ppts. Other industries—especially domestic-demand-oriented downstream manufacturers such as cement products, food & beverages, recreational goods and furniture—continued to show weak profit growth.

【CITIC Securities: Hidden Inventories Surface, Lithium Prices Retreat; Strong Downstream Restocking Likely To Support Rebound】CITIC Securities research says as newly arrived supply is largely absorbed by demand, previously hidden older inventory is gradually surfacing. SMM (Shanghai Metals Market) has adjusted its inventory structure to raise sample coverage of traders and cell makers, rendering traders' hidden stock and cell makers' customer-supplied reserves visible. The new-sample latest weekly inventory stood at 137,000 t, down 0.8% WoW; the old-sample weekly inventory was 101,000 t, down 1.2% WoW. During the week, as prices fell further, purchase intent strengthened, restocking willingness rose and buying activity became active. Lithium carbonate output edged lower this week, mainly due to spodumene-line maintenance; due to tight feedstock, output is expected to remain on a downward trend in May–June. Downstream energy-storage production scheduling remains at a high level and a rebound in demand momentum provides base support, leaving lithium prices in a short-term consolidation phase.

【機構：油價因可能的技術性回撥而上漲】週三結算價走低後，油價在亞洲早盤交易中因可能的技術性回撥而上漲。XS.com的Antonio Di Giacomo在一封電子郵件中表示，在對供應受限的擔憂下，最近幾周油價一直保持在高位。“儘管一些報道表明華盛頓和德黑蘭之間取得了外交進展，但市場仍然認為地緣政治風險並未完全消失，這使得大宗商品和貨幣的波動性保持在高位，“該高階市場分析師表示。近月西得州中質油期貨上漲1.9%，報每桶90.38美元，而近月布倫特原油期貨上漲2.0%，報每桶96.15美元。

【中東緊張局勢和通脹擔憂持續之際 金價小幅走低】金價在前市小幅走低，隨著達成美伊協議的希望減弱，金價持續承壓。現貨黃金下跌0.1%，至每盎司4,451.34美元。XS.com的Antonio Di Giacomo表示，儘管黃金仍被視為避險資產，但地緣政治不確定性、通脹壓力和加息預期的交織引發了大規模獲利了結。他補充說，儘管存在脆弱的停火和對話跡象，但重新爆發衝突的風險仍然很高。不過，也有人表示，黃金具有結構性支撐，因為經濟放緩、主權債務不斷增加以及政治風險在中長期內有利於防禦性資產。

LANE, the ECB chief economist, said the ECB's key lesson for the U.S. is that past energy shocks exhibited non-linear dynamics; for example, if inf is very high, various non-linear mechanisms will be triggered.

【Guojin Securities: Safety Value Of Coal And Power Assets Opens Valuation Upside】Guojin Securities research note said Q5500 coal price holds at 830 yuan/ton, up 217 yuan YoY; Shanxi safety regulators may further push short-term coal prices higher and the central level of provincial power prices has moved up in some provinces, supporting expectation of a bottom reversal. Q1 thermal‑power results showed resilience; market‑based trading and capacity payments have offset downside from long‑term contracts. The report is constructive on Q2, expecting the earnings trough to be confirmed then improve sequentially; improved hydrology in the flood season should lift both volumes and prices, and dividend yields highlight allocation value. Compute‑power and power integration is extending from isolated points to regional scale; under an energy‑security logic manufacturing reshoring should expand demand. The security value of coal and power assets opens valuation space. Leading companies have a solid dividend base, combining offensive and defensive characteristics, and have entered an allocation window.

【中信建投：隱性庫存顯性化鋰價回落，下游補庫強有望支撐反彈】中信建投研報表示，隨著市場新貨被需求大量消化，市場隱性老貨逐步顯性化，SMM調整庫存結構，增加貿易商及電芯廠樣本庫存，貿易商隱性庫存及電芯廠客供儲備顯性化，新樣板最新周度庫存13.7萬噸，周環比降0.8%，老樣本週庫存10.1萬噸，環比降1.2%。周內隨著價格進一步走低，買貨意願愈發強烈，補庫備貨意願逐步提升，採買活躍。本週碳酸鋰產量小幅減少，主要受鋰輝石產線檢修影響，五六月由於原料緊張，產出維持下降預期。下游儲能排產持續高位，動力回升提供底部支撐，鋰價短期進入震盪期。
U.S. MILITARY said it carried out a strike in the eastern Pacific that killed two people.

【俄外長：支援非洲國家向殖民者索賠】今日俄羅斯電視臺26日報道稱，當地時間25日，俄羅斯外交部長拉夫羅夫在莫斯科舉辦的“非洲日”招待會上表示，俄羅斯支援非洲國家向前殖民國家索要賠償的訴求，並將此事視作反抗新殖民主義整體鬥爭的一部分。此番發言恰逢“非洲日”——1963年5月25日，非洲聯盟前身“非洲統一組織”成立，將5月25日定為“非洲日”。 拉夫羅夫25日在面向非洲外交官及官員發言時表示，昔日殖民國家仍在持續攫取非洲大陸豐富自然資源帶來的利益，而非洲各國依舊受制於由外部勢力掌控的金融與工業體系。（環球網）

【國金證券：煤與電資產安全價值開啟估值空間】國金證券研報表示，煤價Q5500維持830元/噸，同比漲217元，山西安監或進一步推升短期煤價，部分省份電價中樞上移，期待底部反轉。Q1火電業績展現韌性，市場化交易與容量電價對沖長協下行，看好Q2業績底確認後逐季改善，汛期水文改善帶來量價齊升，股息率凸顯配置價值。算電融合從點狀向區域延展，能源安全邏輯下製造業迴流擴大需求，煤與電資產安全價值開啟估值空間。龍頭公司股息基礎紮實，攻守兼備，已進入配置視窗。

【原油期貨上漲 美伊談判仍在拉鋸且美國據報對伊朗目標發動新打擊】油價繼週三下跌超過5%之後反彈，美國和伊朗在如何重新開放霍爾木茲海峽的問題上仍存在分歧，而且有報道稱伊朗遭新的軍事打擊。布倫特原油期貨升至每桶96美元以上，WTI原油期貨在每桶90美元附近波動。美國總統特朗普說他對談判“不滿意”，白宮否認伊朗方面有關協議草案的報道，報道稱德黑蘭和阿曼將共同管理霍爾木茲海峽。媒體記者在X援引一位美國官員的話報道，美軍對伊朗境內一處對美軍和霍爾木茲海峽交通構成威脅的目標發動了新打擊。本週早些時候，美國曾襲擊霍爾木茲海峽附近的多個地點。布倫特七月原油期貨上漲2.1%，至每桶96.23美元；WTI七月原油期貨上漲1.9%，至每桶90.39美元。
布倫特原油突破94美元/桶，日內漲1.91%。

【JEFFERSON Warns Of inf Risks From Soaring Energy Prices】Federal Reserve Vice Chair JEFFERSON said he expects inf to cool later this year as the effects of tariffs and higher energy costs fade, but warned that inf risks remain tilted to the upside. In the text of a speech planned for Thursday morning in Tokyo at a conference hosted by the BANK OF JAPAN, JEFFERSON said he is watching for signs that energy-cost increases caused by the Iran war are weighing on consumer spending. He also warned he continues to see signs of labor-market softness. JEFFERSON reiterated his view that the central bank’s current policy stance is well positioned to respond to any developments. "I am not making a prediction about the next meeting, and I look forward to discussing with my colleagues the best policy needed to achieve our dual-mandate goals," he said.

【Wang Yi Meets Serbian Foreign Minister Djuric】Local time May 27, 2026, in New York, CHINA FOREIGN MINISTER WANG YI met with Serbian Foreign Minister Djuric. WANG YI said China firmly supports Serbia in safeguarding its national sovereignty and territorial integrity and praised Serbia for adhering to the One‑China principle. He said that in the next phase the key tasks for both sides are to implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state, deepen exchanges at all levels, advance construction of the Hungary‑Serbia railway, expand cooperation in artificial intelligence, new energy and other fields, strengthen coordination and cooperation at the UN and other platforms, and push forward building a China‑Serbia community with a shared future in the new era.

【王毅會見柬埔寨副首相兼外交大臣布拉索昆】當地時間27日，中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅在紐約會見柬埔寨副首相兼外交大臣布拉索昆。 王毅感謝布拉索昆出席安理會高階別會議，在這一重要平臺發出柬方聲音、展現柬方形象、提升柬方影響。面對亂象叢生的國際形勢，與會各方一致呼籲恪守聯合國憲章，踐行多邊主義，發揮聯合國作用，不接受單邊霸凌行徑。當前中柬關係保持強勁勢頭。中柬外長、防長“2+2”戰略對話機制首次會議成功舉行，雙方一致同意將其升級為外交、國防、公安“3+3”機制，體現了中柬關係的高水平互信，預示新的更大發展。中方願同柬方深化全面戰略合作，密切高層交往，推進經貿、能源、執法、互聯互通等領域務實合作，加強多邊協作，推進新時代全天候中柬命運共同體建設。 雙方還就柬泰衝突交換了意見。王毅說，柬泰對話協商取得積極成效。作為柬泰共同的朋友，中方支援雙方堅持對話大方向，願繼續為雙方增進互信、改善關係發揮積極作用。布拉索昆介紹了柬方立場，感謝中方所作建設性努力，願同泰方透過對話減少分歧，逐步實現兩國關係正常化，期待中方繼續予以支援。

【王毅會見哥斯大黎加外長託瓦爾】當地時間27日，中共中央政治局委員、外交部長王毅在紐約會見哥斯大黎加外長託瓦爾。 王毅轉達習近平主席對費爾南德斯總統的問候。他說，習主席派特使出席哥總統權力交接儀式，費爾南德斯總統表示將深化哥中友誼，強化雙邊關係，中方對此表示讚賞。哥斯大黎加是新世紀中美洲首個同中國建交的國家，也是首個同中國建立戰略伙伴關係、簽署自貿協定的國家，在發展對華關係上走在中美洲國家前列。中方對哥政策保持連續性穩定性。6月1日將迎來中哥建交19週年。19年來，雙邊關係取得長足發展。兩國務實合作碩果累累。哥總統權力交接儀式舉辦地就是中國援建的國家體育場，已成為兩國合作和友誼的象徵。事實充分證明，中哥關係符合兩國長遠戰略利益，造福兩國人民。 王毅強調，臺灣問題是中國核心利益中的核心。聯合國對臺灣的唯一稱謂就是中國臺灣省。相信哥新政府將繼續恪守一箇中國原則。中方始終是哥方可以依賴的朋友和夥伴。我們將從南南合作角度加強對哥合作，助力哥加快國家現代化程序。

【美聯儲副主席傑斐遜稱關注能源價格飆升帶來的通脹風險】美聯儲副主席菲利普·傑斐遜表示，隨著關稅和能源成本上漲的影響逐漸消退，預計今年晚些時候通脹將會降溫；但他警告稱，通脹風險仍然偏向上行。傑斐遜計劃週四上午在東京由日本央行主辦的會議上發表講話。他在講話稿中表示，他正在密切關注伊朗戰爭導致的能源成本上漲是否會抑制消費者支出。他還警告說，他持續看到勞動力市場疲軟的跡象。傑斐遜重申了他的觀點，即美聯儲目前的政策立場能夠很好地應對任何事態發展。“我相信，這一政策立場使我們能夠根據根據最新資料、不斷變化的經濟前景和風險平衡，很好地應對經濟動態。”傑斐遜說，“我沒有預先判斷下次會議，期待與同事們探討實現我們雙重使命目標所需的政策。”

【日經指數下跌0.6%，受科技和金屬股拖累】隨著近期美伊和平協議前景的不確定性持續存在，日本股市走低。日經指數下跌0.6%，至64594.99點。科技股和金屬股領跌。軟銀集團下跌4.7%，Mitsui Kinzoku下跌5.6%。美國總統特朗普表示，如果伊朗認為他會軟化立場以避免與德黑蘭陷入長期僵局，那就是打錯算盤了。投資者正密切關注中東局勢的發展。
【浙江全面提升水安全保障水平】近日，浙江省政府辦公廳印發《浙江省“十五五”水安全保障規劃》，規劃期限為2026—2030年。《規劃》明確，到2030年，浙江將實現水利現代化省域先行；縣級以上城市供水水源足量優質；全面建成浙東南、浙中、浙北三大水資源配置通道，國家水網排程中心浙江分中心投入實戰等目標。

【美聯儲官員稱通脹率過高，首要任務是壓低通脹】明尼阿波利斯聯儲行長尼爾·卡什卡利週四表示，相較就業市場，他認為當前的首要任務是壓低通脹，並直言美國通脹率“太高了”。卡什卡利說：“我非常關注通脹問題。我絕不會忽視勞動力市場。我們需要兼顧兩者，但目前的勞動力市場狀況良好，而通脹率卻過高。”他補充說，通脹持續高企的時間越長，通脹預期脫離錨定並進一步走高的風險就越高，“如果這種情況發生，我們就必須採取更積極的應對措施，所以我們最好還是採取必要措施來穩定通脹預期。”

【“戰爭金屬”告急，美加速重建鎢供應鏈】據美國全國廣播公司25日報道，自2月底中東衝突爆發以來，美國先進武器和彈藥的庫存正在急劇消耗。戰事延宕不僅引發了導彈成品的“庫存荒”，更將危機傳導至上游，使製造這些武器必需的“戰爭金屬”——鎢面臨供應短缺。 鎢極其堅硬且高度耐熱，由於能顯著提升武器穿透裝甲或地下掩體的效能，它被廣泛應用於戰鬥機、穿甲彈，以及導彈系統中。 然而，補充這些損耗正面臨現實挑戰。美國全國廣播公司稱，全球真正具備大規模生產能力的鎢礦並不多，且開採加工難度極高。自2015年以來，美國國內就已經沒有處於運營狀態的商業鎢礦。目前，鎢的生產和提煉主要由中國主導，其鎢礦產量佔全球供應量的80%以上。而美國的鎢主要依賴回收利用和大量進口——據美國地質調查局的資料，美國每年需要進口6000多噸的加工鎢。 面對供應壓力，美國正加速重建本土及盟友體系內的鎢供應鏈。2月份，白宮啟動了價值120億美元的計劃，用於儲備包括鎢在內的多種關鍵礦產。此外，白宮還向國內的採礦專案提供了財政支援，並試圖與世界各地的美國盟友建立礦產合作關係。（環球時報）

Gold Holds Losses on US-Iran Deadlock — Gold traded near $4,450 an ounce on Thursday after falling for two consecutive sessions, as ongoing uncertainty surrounding US-Iran peace negotiations kept concerns over inflation and prolonged high interest rates firmly in focus. Key disagreements remain unresolved, including Tehran’s insistence on maintaining control of the Strait of Hormuz and preserving its nuclear program. President Donald Trump also reiterated that the US would not agree to what he called a bad deal and rejected easing sanctions on Iran despite Tehran’s demands for financial relief and an end to attacks. Even if both sides move closer to a deal, elevated energy prices are still expected to fuel inflationary pressures and encourage central banks to keep interest rates higher for longer, rather than proceed with the rate cuts. Gold is currently down more than 15% since the conflict began.

【何庭波：外部環境限制給我們設立了很苛刻的約束條件，但也給了我們更純粹的工作動力】人民日報釋出對華為公司董事、半導體業務部總裁何庭波的專訪。何庭波表示，面對各種困難，我們沒有後退，竭盡全力地奮鬥。我們引以為傲的就是笨信念、笨功夫。只要方向是對的，慢一點也沒關係，一直往前走，終歸可以找到橋和路。結果就是依靠對基礎理論研究的堅持和實踐，我們不僅打通了路，而且建了高速公路。我們是一家以工程師為主的公司，工程師的工作就是解決各種問題。外部環境限制給我們設立了很苛刻的約束條件，但也給了我們更純粹的工作動力。大部分時間，團隊都是堅定、安靜，而且是冷靜地工作。因為只有在冷靜、專注、排除干擾的情況下，真誠、開放、深刻地探討問題，才能找到解決問題的路徑。

【“韜定律”能否給全球的晶片產業指出新的方向？ 何庭波回應】人民日報釋出對華為公司董事、半導體業務部總裁何庭波的專訪。何庭波表示，這是華為基礎理論研究的一個突破，不僅對晶片本身很重要，對整個半導體行業同樣很重要。未來5年到10年，半導體行業將遇到障礙，一定會認真思考“韜定律”這條路徑。摩爾定律從提出到被行業完全接受，用了10年的時間。作為一個工程師，當然不希望自己從事的事情永遠是瓶頸。我們公佈“韜定律”的實踐和規劃，總體是比較有信心，比6年以來任何時候都有信心。有人可能3天后就加入我們的行列，也有人可能要等三五年，我們都歡迎，需要更多的實踐來證明，希望大家能一起把這件事做得更好。

【Huawei Board Member He Tingbo Says Moore's Law Will Hit Physical 'Wall' Within 10 Years; Huawei Faced It Earlier Than Peers】People's Daily published an interview with He Tingbo, Huawei board member and president of the semiconductor business unit. He said chips face two key constraints: a necessary constraint — Moore's Law will encounter a physical 'wall' within the next 10 years — and a contingent constraint caused by external environmental limits, meaning Huawei has hit this 'wall' earlier than peers. He said this prompted reflection that the essence of Moore's Law is not about compressing space but delivering faster speed, more functions and more affordable prices. As an analogy, he said a city that must add more parks, schools and hospitals becomes crowded and commuting time increases; one key technical idea in the 'Tao Law' concept is 'logical folding' — stacking one urban area onto another and installing millions of elevators between areas according to logical relationships so direct distance is reduced, time is saved and additional functions can be provided.

【北京：大力推進“好房子”建設】《中共北京市委 北京市人民政府關於推動城市高質量發展的實施意見》正式對外發布。其中提出，大力推進“好房子”建設。構建符合首都特點的房地產發展新模式，全鏈條提升住房設計、建造、維護、服務水平，更好滿足群眾剛性和多樣化改善性住房需求。開展“適居行動”，增加“一張床、一間房”產品供給，改善城市執行服務保障人員居住條件。穩步推進靈活就業人員參加住房公積金制度。

【華為公司董事、半導體業務部總裁何庭波：華為比同行更早遇到這堵“牆”】人民日報釋出對華為公司董事、半導體業務部總裁何庭波的專訪。何庭波表示，就華為而言，晶片有兩個關鍵約束。一個是必然約束，摩爾定律在未來10年會遇到物理邊界的“牆”。另一個是偶然約束，受到外部環境限制，華為比同行更早遇到這堵“牆”。這讓我思考，摩爾定律的本質並不是為了壓縮空間，而是更快的速度、更多的功能、更可承擔的價格。打個比方，一個城市要建更多的公園、學校、醫院，但是城市會擁擠，上班通勤時間會變長，怎麼解決？“韜定律”的一個關鍵技術是邏輯摺疊，就是把城市的一個區域“疊”到另一個區域上面，兩個區域間根據邏輯關係安裝幾百萬臺電梯，這樣直達的距離不會太遠，時間也變得節約，還可以提供更多的功能。

【北京：建立可持續的城市建設運營投融資體系】《中共北京市委 北京市人民政府關於推動城市高質量發展的實施意見》正式對外發布。其中提出，建立可持續的城市建設運營投融資體系。深化投資審批制度改革，加強政府投資全過程管理，最佳化實施“兩重”建設專案，提高民生、安全投資比重。加強政府債務管理。完善政府和社會資本合作模式，發展耐心資本，激發投資活力。強化中長期信貸供給，鼓勵保險、信託等機構提供金融服務，用好不動產投資信託基金（REITs）等產品。建立基礎設施投資、價格、補貼聯動機制，強化成本統籌。

【北京：加快建設中關村世界領先科技園區】《中共北京市委 北京市人民政府關於推動城市高質量發展的實施意見》正式對外發布。其中提出，科技創新引領新質生產力。加快建設中關村世界領先科技園區，深化“科學+城”建設，營造具有全球競爭力的創新生態。統籌“三城一區”聯動發展，強化中關村科學城科技創新與產業創新策源功能，突出懷柔科學城重大科技基礎設施集中優勢，推動未來科學城重點領域能級躍升，支援創新產業叢集示範區承接創新成果和產業資源。保持先進製造業合理比重，強化新一代資訊科技、醫藥健康等萬億級產業叢集。擴大科技、金融、商務等服務業優勢，深化“兩業融合”，做優做強總部經濟。

Brent Rises on US-Iran Deal Uncertainties — Brent crude futures climbed toward $96 per barrel on Thursday, recovering some losses from the previous session as negotiations between the US and Iran remained deadlocked over several key issues tied to ending the conflict. Among the main obstacles are Tehran’s demands to maintain control of the Strait of Hormuz and preserve its nuclear program. President Donald Trump also reiterated that Washington would not accept what he described as a bad deal, while rejecting any sanctions relief despite Iran’s calls for an end to attacks and economic concessions. Meanwhile, Iranian state television reported the existence of an unofficial draft agreement aimed at halting the war, though the White House dismissed the claim as “a complete fabrication.” Even so, oil prices remain on track for a second straight weekly decline amid expectations that both sides could eventually secure a peace agreement and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

【美國指控谷歌工程師在Polymarket平臺進行內幕交易】據週三解封的一份起訴書顯示，美國司法部指控一名谷歌軟體工程師利用內幕資訊，在預測市場Polymarket上操縱與谷歌熱門搜尋榜相關的投注，從中獲利120萬美元。據起訴書稱，36歲的義大利公民米歇爾·斯帕尼烏洛（Michele Spagnuolo）涉嫌利用內幕資訊，押注於獨立流行音樂人D4vd等勝算極小的候選人。此前，D4vd因被捕並被指控謀殺一名少女，其名字出現在谷歌年度搜尋榜單上。根據谷歌12月4日釋出的統計資料，D4vd是該年度搜尋量最高的人物，而斯帕尼烏洛據稱在11月27日下注時利用了內幕資訊，押注D4vd將位居榜首。據起訴書稱，這筆賭注特別賺錢，因為市場認為D4vd成為谷歌搜尋量最高人物的機率“接近於零”。起訴書稱，斯帕尼烏洛還透過名為“AlphaRaccoon”的賬戶，利用內幕資訊對谷歌年度搜尋榜單進行了其他投注。紐約南區聯邦檢察官傑伊·克萊頓（Jay Clayton）在一份宣告中表示，檢方將追究那些企圖利用商業機密在預測市場牟利的公司內部人士。

【天辰生物-B5月28日至6月2日招股 擬全球發售1419.32萬股】天辰生物-B(01779)於2026年5月28日至2026年6月2日招股，該公司擬全球發售1419.32萬股H股(視乎超額配股權行使與否而定)，其中，香港發售佔10%，國際發售佔90%，另有15%超額配股權。發售價將為每股發售股份96.06港元，每手50股，預期H股將於2026年6月5日上午九時正開始在聯交所買賣。公司是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司。公司於2020年成立，位於中國上海和蘇州常熟，主要專注於針對過敏性及自身免疫性疾病的生物藥物的自主發現與開發。

【大金重工5月28日至6月2日招股 擬全球發售8696.58萬股】大金重工(01081)於2026年5月28日至2026年6月2日招股，該公司擬全球發售8696.58萬股H股，其中，香港發售佔10%，國際發售佔90%，另有15%超額配股權。發售價將為每股發售股份66.40港元，每手100股，預期H股將於2026年6月5日上午九時正開始在聯交所買賣。公司是一家全球領先的海上風電核心裝備供應商，深耕風力發電行業近二十年，為全球大型海上風電開發商提供風電基礎裝備“建造+運輸+交付”一站式解決方案。

【德琪醫藥-B：ATG-022用於治療CLDN18.2+晚期胃或胃食管結合部(GEJ)腺癌的關鍵性III期CLINCH-3研究獲中國臨床批件】德琪醫藥-B(06996)釋出公告，經中國國家藥品監督管理局(藥監局)藥品審評中心(藥審中心)審評，本公司已獲藥審中心核准同意開展關於ATG-022(一種Claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2)抗體偶聯藥物(ADC))用於治療CLDN18.2+晚期胃或胃食管結合部(GEJ)腺癌的關鍵性III期CLINCH-3研究。該研究預計將首先於中國啟動，並計劃作為一項多區域臨床試驗(MRCT)開展。

【劍橋科技將配售股份籌集約19.8億港元】據在香港交易所的公告，劍橋科技將以每股126.66港元的價格，配售1,560萬股股份。配售股份佔擴大後已發行股份總數的4.24%。配售價較最後收盤價139港元折讓8.88%。配售所得款項總額約為19.8億港元（2.53億美元）。所得資金將用於集團核心元件的戰略性儲備、補充營運資金及其他一般企業用途。國泰海通和美銀證券擔任聯席配售代理。

【市場分析：火箭壟斷使SpaceX在IPO競賽中相比OpenAI擁有優勢】雖然SpaceX和OpenAI存在巨大差異，但這兩宗上市交易必然會引發外界的比較。SpaceX預計將於下個月中旬的某個時候掛牌上市，尋求的公開市場估值約為1.5萬億美元。與此同時，ChatGPT母公司OpenAI在私募市場的最新估值為8,520億美元，這強烈暗示該公司同樣懷有達到萬億美元估值的雄心。重要的是，馬斯克已成功將SpaceX打造成一家擁有深厚競爭護城河的獨特企業。相比之下，在OpenAI走向公開上市之際，Alphabet旗下谷歌和Anthropic等公司已經構建了具有競爭力的AI模型，正在蠶食ChatGPT的先發優勢。要支撐如此高昂的市值，SpaceX和OpenAI的規模都還相對較小。SpaceX在2025年創造了187億美元的收入，而媒體獲得的資料顯示，OpenAI同期的收入為131億美元。就收入規模而言，這將使兩家公司在標普500指數成分股中處於中游水平。根據標普全球市場財智的資料，該指數中目前市值超過1萬億美元的11家公司平均年度收入略高於2,600億美元。對SpaceX而言，1.5萬億美元的市值將代表投資者對馬斯克至少能實現其部分科幻夢想抱有極大信心。但就眼下而言，SpaceX已經開發出了一種難以複製的獨特商業模式。
【聯邦快遞貨運控股公司即將加入標普500指數】5月28日，據報道，聯邦快遞貨運控股公司即將加入標普500指數。與此同時，資訊科技服務提供商EpamSystems以及金融科技公司Dave，將被納入標普小盤600指數。

【在美日資企業儲罐內爆事故9名失蹤者被推定死亡】美國華盛頓州當地官員27日說，前一天朗維尤市日資企業化學儲罐內爆事故的死亡人數已升至兩人，另外，失蹤的9人已被推定死亡。 當地消防部門說，涉事儲罐容量約為90萬加侖（1加侖合3.79升），大量腐蝕性化學品洩漏。由於受損儲罐結構不穩定，現場仍存在接觸腐蝕性化學品的風險，相關行動將“緩慢、有序、謹慎”進行。找到遇難者遺體後，將先進行去汙處理，再送往法醫部門進行身份確認。 美國化學安全與危害調查委員會說，事故涉及一個裝有“白液”的大型儲罐發生內爆並破裂，造成多人死亡和重傷，調查人員將趕赴現場。“白液”是用於造紙加工的腐蝕性化學液體。事故發生在日本製紙集團旗下企業位於朗維尤的工廠。該企業一名負責人27日表示，目前重點是協助救援人員搜尋失蹤者，同時為遇難者家屬和員工提供支援。

【A股限售股解禁一覽：44.87億元市值限售股今日解禁】Wind資料顯示，週四（5月28日），共有8家公司限售股解禁，合計解禁量為6.59億股，按最新收盤價計算，合計解禁市值為44.87億元。從解禁量來看，2家公司解禁股數超千萬股。中泰證券、崑崙萬維、微導奈米解禁量居前，解禁股數分別為6.37億股、1129.09萬股、330.44萬股。從解禁市值來看，2家公司解禁市值超億元。中泰證券、崑崙萬維、微導奈米解禁市值居前，解禁市值分別為35.67億元、5.17億元、2.65億元。從解禁股數佔總股本比例來看，中泰證券、科捷智慧、華陽變速解禁比例居前，解禁比例分別為8.04%、1.59%、1.08%。
新加坡交易所日經股指期貨開盤下跌20點，報65035點。
美國10年期國債期貨下跌4個基點，30年期國債期貨因伊朗遭襲擊訊息下跌6個基點。

【日本擬發行過渡債券為投資計劃募資】據日經新聞週四報道，日本計劃發行過渡債券，為政府重點專案提供資金，相關專案旨在加大對增長領域與經濟安全領域的投資。過渡債券用於彌補短期資金缺口，發行時會明確約定具體償債來源並提供相應保障。報道未援引訊息人士，稱執政黨自民黨將於週四向政府提交相關提案，發行過渡債券的構想便包含其中。報道還表示，日本政府計劃將該發債方案納入定於7月出爐的中期財政規劃。日本首相辦公室暫未就此置評。

【LOF炒作情緒升溫 2只基金連續漲停】5月27日，市場多數股票調整，高景氣賽道降溫，防禦性與低估值板塊相對錶現較好，酒、煤炭、電力相關ETF逆勢上行。值得關注的是，多隻LOF大漲，財通福鑫定開混合、財通福享混合LOF漲停，這兩隻LOF分別已連續四個、三個交易日漲停，其中，財通福享混合LOF低開高走，溢價率高企。從資金流向來看，5月26日資金繼續淨流出寬基指數ETF，但淨流出規模有所下降。此外，資金大舉追捧半導體及晶片ETF，相關產品合計淨流入逾70億元。（中國證券報）

【波音徵詢FAA意見後將提高737月產量】波音執行長奧特伯格(Kelly Ortberg)週三表示，在與美國聯邦航空管理局(FAA)協商後，波音將把737系列飛機的月產量從42架提升至47架。奧特伯格在伯恩斯坦年度戰略決策會議上表示：“我們已開始按每月47架的速度推進，應該能夠在未來幾個月達到這個水平。”在華盛頓州埃弗雷特市(Everett)開通第四條737生產線後，波音計劃於明年年初將月產量提升至52架。“我認為全世界都在關注，確保我們能實現每月47架和52架的生產目標，”奧特伯格表示。
美國原油期貨受美軍襲擊伊朗軍事設施影響，上漲超1美元，報每桶89.96美元。

【扎克伯格稱Meta考慮進軍雲端計算市場】Meta執行長馬克·扎克伯格在週三的年度股東大會上表示，如果他的公司在資料中心方面支出過高，導致算力過剩，則可能會進軍雲端計算市場。“這絕對在考慮範圍內，”扎克伯格在回答有關公司是否會在雲端計算領域與亞馬遜和微軟展開競爭的問題時說道。他表示：“我們還沒有這樣做，因為我們認為計算能力對我們有用。當然，如果我們覺得計算能力已經過剩，那也是我們可以考慮的選項，這也正是我們對投資建設這項技術充滿信心的原因之一。”

【U.S. Says It Struck Iranian Military Facility, Downed Multiple Drones】Refinitiv, citing U.S. military officials, reported the U.S. carried out a new strike on an Iranian military facility and intercepted and shot down multiple unmanned aerial vehicles; the facility and those drones, officials said, "posed a threat to U.S. forces and commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz."
據路透社援引美軍官員訊息報道，美軍“對一處伊朗軍事設施實施了新的打擊，並攔截擊落了多架無人機”。據稱該設施和這些無人機“對霍爾木茲海峽的美軍部隊及商業航運構成了威脅”。（ CCTV國際時訊  ）

【頭部公募機構招兵買馬 投研補強進行時】公募基金行業正上演著一場人才的“遷徙”。楊思亮、姜曉麗、白冰洋、李崟、邵凱等多位知名基金經理選擇加入易方達基金、廣發基金、富國基金、中歐基金等頭部公募機構。多位公募人士認為，在費率改革、限薪考核新規落地、投研模式轉型等多重因素共振的背景下，公募人才流動性攀升，行業馬太效應深化，形成人才向頭部機構聚攏的現象。在構建有序良性的人才流動生態的同時，行業內部也要保障投研延續性，夯實行業長期健康發展的基礎。（中國證券報）
【特朗普稱美國將建立“經得起未來考驗”的加密貨幣市場結構】美國總統特朗普表示，美國將建立一種“經得起未來考驗”的數字資產市場結構，使其不會被加密貨幣行業的反對者“推翻”。特朗普在Truth Social上發帖談及加密貨幣行業。特朗普指責前美國證券交易委員會主席加里·根斯勒將比特幣和加密貨幣永續產品驅趕到“海外”；並重申其主張，美國如今已是“世界加密貨幣之都”。

【伊朗阿巴斯港附近傳爆炸聲 防空系統啟動】據伊朗法爾斯通訊社報道，當地時間28日凌晨1時30分左右，伊朗南部城市阿巴斯港以東傳出三聲爆炸聲。與此同時，阿巴斯港的防空系統啟動，開火數分鐘。發生爆炸的具體方位和原因尚不清楚。當地政府正在進行調查。當地時間25日深夜，阿巴斯港同樣傳出三聲爆炸聲。美軍中央司令部隨後釋出的訊息和美國媒體報道顯示，美軍對兩艘試圖在霍爾木茲海峽佈雷的伊朗船隻以及阿巴斯港的伊朗防空導彈發射陣地進行“自衛性”空襲。伊朗指責美方違反停火協議。法爾斯通訊社28日還報道說，過去4天，伊朗武裝部隊在阿巴斯港所在的霍爾木茲甘省擊落一架美軍大型無人機、一架以色列“軌道器”型偵察無人機。（新華社）

【Multiple Regions Push Ticket‑Stub Economy To Convert Traffic Into Retention】Since Q2, multiple Chinese regions have rolled out consumer vouchers. This round of voucher issuance shows a new trend: the rise of a "ticket‑stub economy," where vouchers are no longer limited to simple discount coupons but are deeply tied to ticket stubs for sporting events, performances, movie tickets, air tickets, high‑speed rail tickets and exhibitions, connecting the full eat‑stay‑travel‑play‑shop‑entertain consumption chain. In fact, this year Shandong, Chongqing, Guangxi and Guizhou included measures to develop the ticket‑stub economy in their government work reports; Shandong proposes to "build a ticket‑stub economy ecosystem," Chongqing proposes to "develop the silver economy, first‑release economy, ticket‑stub economy and emotion economy," and Guangxi explicitly says it will "vigorously support the development of ticket‑stub economies for events and performances."

Russia Industrial Output Rises for 2nd Month — Industrial production in Russia rose by 1.9% year-on-year in April 2026, surpassing market expectations of a 1.6% increase but easing from a 2.3% gain in the previous month. Still, the latest figure marked the second consecutive month of growth, largely driven by increased production in the manufacturing sector, which grew 3.1% from 3% in March. Output mainly increased in the manufacture of transport equipment (57.4% vs 32.6%), fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment (23% vs 0.8%), and basic pharmaceutical products and preparations (15.4% vs 15.9%). In addition, activity rose for electricity, gas, steam, and air conditioning supply (0.9% vs 0.1%) and water supply, sewerage, waste management and remediation services (0.9% vs -2.4%). Meanwhile, output declined for mining and quarrying (-0.4% vs 1%). On a monthly basis, industrial activity dropped by 4.1%, reversing a 12.4% rise in March.

【國產記憶體龍頭長鑫科技IPO過會 儲存產業估值邏輯生變】5月27日，作為國產儲存“雙子星”之一，長鑫科技科創板IPO透過上交所上市委會議，公司IPO擬募集資金295億元，創下科創板IPO擬募資額之最。日前證券時報記者實探長鑫科技合肥廠區，施工車輛出入頻繁，配套的裝置、材料等半導體產業鏈企業在廠區周邊高度聚集。在儲存超級週期演化下，記憶體產品內部利潤率出現倒掛，通用型DDR產品利潤率反超高階HBM類產品，儲存巨頭美光科技最新重啟上一代規格DDR4記憶體生產。隨著儲存被視為AI算力的關鍵基礎設施，外資機構對國際儲存巨頭改用成長股估值，行業或迎來估值邏輯重構。

【Snowflake與AWS擴大合作，承諾投入60億美元加速企業代理AI應用】當地時間5月27日，人工智慧資料雲公司Snowflake宣佈，已與亞馬遜網路服務（AWS）簽署了一項為期多年的戰略合作協議（SCA），旨在加速企業對代理式人工智慧的採用，幫助全球共同客戶更快、更安全地構建和部署人工智慧。作為此次合作擴充套件的一部分，Snowflake向AWS承諾投入60億美元用於基礎設施建設，這是該公司迄今為止最大規模的投入，反映出企業在AWS上執行AI和資料工作負載的需求正在加速增長。

【機構預測業績高增長的AI智慧體概念股梳理】5月26日，支付寶在杭州宣佈，“AI支付”已累計完成3億筆AI智慧體（Agent）支付，並支援95%的通用智慧體框架。近期，三部門聯合印發《智慧體規範應用與創新發展實施意見》，明確了19個典型應用場景，為智慧體產業的落地按下了“加速鍵”。AI智慧體涉及概念股眾多，據證券時報·資料寶統計，截至5月27日收盤，AI智慧體概念股合計A股市值接近2.4萬億元，年內平均下跌3.47%。近期AI智慧體概念股成交活躍度提升明顯。據資料寶統計，相關個股5月以來日均成交額均值達到7.84億元，環比增長30.02%。22股日均成交額環比增幅在100%以上，其中南威軟體、阿爾特、賽意資訊、美格智慧、嘉環科技日均成交額環比增幅排在前五位。未來增長潛力方面，根據5家及以上機構一致預測，今明兩年淨利潤增速均有望超20%的AI智慧體概念股有17只。以最新收盤價與年內高點相比，這17只股票中，回撤幅度逾20%的有10只，包括合合資訊、迪安診斷、稅友股份、青木科技、漢得資訊等。

The U.S. MILITARY also intercepted and shot down multiple Iranian drones that threatened U.S. MILITARY and commercial maritime traffic.

【英國5月消費服務業信心指數跌至一年多來最低點】英國工業聯盟(CBI)週四釋出的一項調查顯示，本月英國面向消費者的服務業企業的信心指數下跌至2025年2月以來最低點，而商業服務業近期出現的信心回升勢頭，也出現了逆轉。“利潤正在急劇下降，企業被迫縮減投資並裁減員工，”CBI經濟調查與資料經理Charlotte Dendy表示。她補充道：“隨著未來幾個月通脹率預計將上升，消費者將更加謹慎，這將給本已低迷的需求環境帶來進一步壓力。”由於成本上漲速度超過了企業提價能力，消費服務企業的整體盈利能力以2020年8月以來最快的速度下滑。消費服務行業的樂觀指數從2月的負45下降至5月的負49，創下2025年2月以來的最低水平。商業及專業服務行業的樂觀指數從2月的負3下降至5月的負46，創2025年11月以來新低。

UK Car Production Falls 0.7% in April — UK car production dropped 0.7% year-on-year to 56,135 units in April 2026, following a 0.8% decline in the previous month, while car exports shrank 8.2%. The EU remained the largest destination, accounting for 53.2% of exports, with shipments rising 6.9% to 23,103 units.

【北京釋出城市高質量發展實施意見】5月28日，《中共北京市委 北京市人民政府關於推動城市高質量發展的實施意見》正式對外發布。《實施意見》把“全面落實首都城市戰略定位，持續提升首都功能”作為第一項任務予以部署。在政治中心方面，全力做好服務保障，推進中央政務功能佈局最佳化；在文化中心方面，做好歷史文化保護傳承利用，深化文明交流互鑑；在國際交往中心方面，完善國際化設施和服務，打造賓至如歸的世界會客廳；在科技創新中心方面，加快建設中關村世界領先科技園區，努力打造全球重要科學策源地和高水平人才高地。（央視）

【Analysts: Lithium Ore, Lithium Salts May Face Medium- to Long-Term "Tight Supply-Demand Balance"】Year-to-date, lithium carbonate prices have trended upward with volatility; cumulative gains since the start of the year have exceeded 60% at the high end. On May 27, the main lithium carbonate contract on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange closed at 173,000 yuan/ton. Although this is somewhat below recent peaks, the year-to-date increase remains substantial. Several analysts say the current price rally is driven by multiple supply-side disruptions coinciding with stronger-than-expected demand; industry supply and demand are expected to be in a tight balance this year, which should help keep the lithium price mid-point elevated and prone to oscillation.

【歐盟衛星頻譜分配向本土企業傾斜並限制美企份額，兼顧安全與產業競爭】歐洲週三宣佈了一項計劃，將把大部分移動衛星頻譜分配給歐洲企業，同時減少美國運營商可獲得的份額。這是其減少對科技巨頭的依賴並促進本土企業發展的部分舉措。馬斯克的星鏈(Starlink)和亞馬遜的低軌道衛星業務是衛星網際網路市場的主要參與者，分析師表示，歐盟最新衛星頻譜計劃可能會使這些美國競爭對手處於不利地位。歐盟執委會表示，三分之一的頻譜將保留用於安全和軍事等國家用途，並由一家歐盟運營商提供，該運營商將把這一能力與歐盟由290顆衛星組成的IRIS2多軌道衛星系統整合。IRIS2是歐洲版“星鏈”。歐盟執委會表示，剩餘三分之二頻譜將平均分配給歐盟和非歐盟運營商，用於商業用途。此舉是一項折中方案，此前至少有一位歐盟執委會委員曾希望將美國運營商排除在外。歐盟執委會表示，作為過渡安排的一部分，美國公司Viasat和EchoStarSATS.O的2GHz頻段許可證將在2027年5月到期後再延長兩年。

【多家頭部券商中期策略會展望下半年：AI仍是市場熱門賽道】近日，中信證券、華泰證券、中信建投證券、瑞銀證券等券商密集召開中期策略會，釋出下半年市場研判報告，把脈A股市場結構性投資主線與整體盈利走向。人工智慧（AI）仍是市場熱門賽道，多家海內外機構一致看好其長期投資價值，板塊資金聚集尚未達到極致，產業應用等新方向也值得關注。此外，受供需格局失衡影響，能源、貴金屬、工業金屬等資源品，成為機構配置中兼顧避險與收益的重要選擇。
【加沙民眾為遇襲身亡的哈馬斯軍事領導人送葬 】哈馬斯27日發表宣告說，其軍事領導人穆罕默德·奧達及其妻子和兩個兒子在以色列26日對加沙城一棟居民樓的空襲中身亡。5月27日，民眾在加沙城為遭以軍空襲身亡的哈馬斯軍事領導人穆罕默德·奧達及其家人送葬。（新華社）

【公募基金淨值首破39萬億元再創新高 穩健型資產是擴張主力】5月27日，中基協公佈的資料顯示，截至2026年4月底，公募基金資產淨值合計39.36萬億元，規模再創歷史新高。從基金種類來看，穩健型資產依然是基金規模擴張的絕對主力。資料顯示，4月份貨幣基金和債券基金淨值環比分別大幅增長6415.29億元和5127.54億元，合計增長1.15萬億元。權益類資產方面，受益於股市上漲，股票型基金和混合基金呈現“份額減少、規模增多”的特徵。混合基金的份額環比減少了265.19億份，降幅為1.01%；淨值大增3923.16億元，環比增幅高達10.40%。股票型基金份額縮水1614.68億份，淨值增長1649.29億元。

【Meta將推出AI聊天機器人訂閱服務，月費最低7.99美元】據報道，Meta首次開始向消費者銷售MetaAI聊天機器人訂閱服務，或將有助於部分抵消其在AI領域的鉅額支出。新推出的訂閱服務分為兩檔。公司發言人表示，基礎檔名為Meta One Plus，月費7.99美元，面向頻繁使用Meta AI生成圖片和影片，或依賴其進行復雜推理的使用者。該發言人補充稱，更高階別的Meta One Premium月費為19.99美元，包含與Meta One Plus相同的功能，但使用額度更高。

【中國駐瑞典大使周立民訪問沃爾沃汽車集團總部】據“中國駐瑞典大使館”公眾號訊息，2026年5月27日，駐瑞典大使周立民訪問沃爾沃汽車集團總部，與執行長塞繆爾森等就中瑞汽車產業合作進行深入交流。  周大使表示，吉利與沃爾沃汽車的合作是中瑞經貿關係濃墨重彩的一筆，是兩國合作的典範。希望沃爾沃汽車依託吉利，全面嵌入中國汽車全產業鏈，深度融入中國新能源汽車創新鏈，利用中國先進的人工智慧、數字、電池等技術，不斷增強全球競爭力，在中國乃至全球取得更大成功。塞繆爾森介紹了公司發展及對華合作情況，表示中國電動汽車產業發展迅猛，同中國合作是企業提升競爭力的必由之路。沃爾沃透過與吉利的合作，創造了獨特發展優勢，願繼續深耕中國市場，交流借鑑創新成果，加強互利合作，實現共同發展。
【邁威爾科技一季度淨營收24.2億美元，略高於市場預期】邁威爾科技公佈第一季度淨營收24.2億美元，市場預期24.1億美元；調整後每股收益為80美分，符合市場預期。邁威爾科技預計第二季度調整後每股收益為88至98美分，市場預期為90美分。

【多地發力票根經濟，推動“流量”轉化為“留量”】二季度以來，全國多地陸續發放消費券。本輪消費券發放呈現一個新趨勢：票根經濟興起，即消費券不再侷限於簡單滿減，而是深度繫結賽事、演出、電影票、機票、高鐵票、展會的票根憑證，打通了“吃住行遊購娛”全鏈條。事實上，今年山東、重慶、廣西、貴州等多地政府工作報告已經對票根經濟發展作出部署。比如，山東提出“構建票根經濟生態圈”；重慶提出“發展銀髮經濟、首發經濟、票根經濟、情緒經濟”；廣西明確“大力支援賽事、演藝等票根經濟發展”。（證券日報）

【谷歌工程師因涉嫌在Polymarket預測市場進行內幕交易遭起訴】谷歌軟體工程師Michele Spagnuolo被控在預測平臺Polymarket上進行內幕交易。據稱，他利用2025年最熱門的網際網路搜尋資料進行下注，獲利超過100萬美元。Spagnuolo在押注“2025 年穀歌搜尋量最高的人物將是歌手 D4vd”時，擁有獲取公司內部追蹤使用者搜尋資料的許可權。當官方正式公佈D4vd為搜尋量榜首時，他據此賺取了約120萬美元。 谷歌已對Spagnuolo做出了停職處理，並正配合執法部門的調查。谷歌表示，利用機密資訊進行押注嚴重違反了公司政策。
【分析人士：鋰礦、鋰鹽或迎中長期“供需緊平衡”】今年以來，碳酸鋰價格呈現震盪上行態勢。自年初至今，其累計漲幅最高超60%。5月27日，廣期所碳酸鋰主力合約收報於17.3萬元/噸，雖然相較於近期價格高位有所回撥，但年內漲幅依然可觀。多位分析人士認為，本輪鋰價上行的核心驅動力來自供應端多重擾動與需求超預期共振，今年行業供需預計將呈現緊平衡狀態，有望支撐鋰價中樞維持高位震盪格局。（證券日報）
